    23→; === EQU Constants (shared) ===
    24→PC_OFFSET			EQU 0  ; 16 bits
    25→REQUESTED_PC_OFFSET	EQU 2  ; 16 bits
    26→INACTIVE_THREAD		EQU 0FFFFh
    27→DELETE_THIS_THREAD	EQU 0FFFEh
    28→NO_REQUEST 			EQU 0FFFFh
    29→
    30→CURRENT_STATE	EQU 0  ; boolean stored as a byte
    31→REQUESTED_STATE	EQU 1  ; boolean stored as a byte
    32→
    33→FROZEN	EQU 0
    34→NOT_FROZEN EQU 1
    35→NO_STATE_REQUEST EQU 0FFh
    36→
    37→; These off-screen video pages are stored in external RAM:
    38→; MAINCPU: in DRAM at 0x020000-0x05FFFF
    39→; EXTENSION: in extension board SRAM at 0x240000-0x27FFFF
    40→	ifdef TARGET_MAINCPU
    41→PAGE_BITMAP_0 EQU 020000h
    42→PAGE_BITMAP_1 EQU 030000h
    43→PAGE_BITMAP_2 EQU 040000h
    44→PAGE_BITMAP_3 EQU 050000h
    45→	endif
    46→	ifdef TARGET_EXTENSION
    47→PAGE_BITMAP_0 EQU 240000h
    48→PAGE_BITMAP_1 EQU 250000h
    49→PAGE_BITMAP_2 EQU 260000h
    50→PAGE_BITMAP_3 EQU 270000h
    51→	endif
    52→
    53→; VM variable indices (used by the game engine)
    54→VM_VARIABLE_RANDOM_SEED		EQU 03Ch
    55→VM_VARIABLE_LAST_KEYCHAR	EQU 0C5h
    56→VM_VARIABLE_HERO_POS_UP_DOWN	EQU 0E5h
    57→VM_VARIABLE_HERO_POS_JUMP_DOWN	EQU 0DCh
    58→VM_VARIABLE_HERO_POS_LEFT_RIGHT	EQU 0E9h
    59→VM_VARIABLE_HERO_POS_MASK	EQU 0FAh
    60→VM_VARIABLE_HERO_ACTION		EQU 0FBh
    61→VM_VARIABLE_HERO_ACTION_POS_MASK EQU 0FBh
    62→VM_VARIABLE_SCROLL_Y		EQU 0F9h
    63→
    64→; Game part IDs
    65→GAME_PART_INTRO			EQU 03E80h
    66→NUM_MEM_LIST			EQU 091h

    68→CALC_LINE_XMAX_AND_XMIN:
    69→	; int16_t xmax = MAX(x1, x2);
    70→	LD WA, (X1)
    71→	CP WA, (X2)
    72→	JP GT, XMAX_OK
    73→	LD WA, (X2)
    74→XMAX_OK:
    75→	LD (LINE_XMAX), WA
    76→	
    77→	; int16_t xmin = MIN(x1, x2);
    78→	LD WA, (X1)
    79→	CP WA, (X2)
    80→	JP LT, XMIN_OK
    81→	LD WA, (X2)
    82→XMIN_OK:
    83→	LD (LINE_XMIN), WA
    84→	RET
    85→
    86→drawLineN:
    87→	; Inputs:
    88→	; C = color
    89→	PUSH XIX
    90→	PUSH XHL
    91→	
    92→	CALL CALC_LINE_XMAX_AND_XMIN
    93→
    94→	; for (int16_t x=xmin; x<=xmax; x++)
    95→	; 	m_curPagePtr1->pix(m_hliney, x) = color;
    96→	LD XIX, (CUR_LINE)
    97→	LD HL, (LINE_XMIN)
    98→	EXTS XHL
    99→	ADD XIX, XHL
   100→	LD HL, (LINE_XMAX)
   101→	SUB HL, (LINE_XMIN)
   102→
   103→drawLineN_loop:
   104→	LDB (XIX), C
   105→	INC XIX
   106→	DJNZ HL, drawLineN_loop
   107→	
   108→	POP XHL
   109→	POP XIX
   110→	RET
   111→
   112→drawLineP:
   113→	; Copy pixels from PAGE_BITMAP_0 to curPagePtr1
   114→	PUSH XIX
   115→	PUSH XIY
   116→	PUSH XHL
   117→
   118→	CALL CALC_LINE_XMAX_AND_XMIN
   119→
   120→	; Destination: CUR_LINE + LINE_XMIN (in curPagePtr1)
   121→	LD XIX, (CUR_LINE)
   122→	LD HL, (LINE_XMIN)
   123→	EXTS XHL
   124→	ADD XIX, XHL
   125→
   126→	; Source: PAGE_BITMAP_0 + HLINEY*320 + LINE_XMIN
   127→	LD XIY, PAGE_BITMAP_0
   128→	LD XWA, 0
   129→	LD WA, (HLINEY)
   130→	LD DE, 320
   131→	MUL XWA, DE
   132→	ADD XIY, XWA
   133→	LD XHL, 0
   134→	LD HL, (LINE_XMIN)
   135→	EXTS XHL
   136→	ADD XIY, XHL
   137→
   138→	; Loop: copy xmax-xmin+1 pixels
   139→	LD HL, (LINE_XMAX)
   140→	SUB HL, (LINE_XMIN)
   141→
   142→drawLineP_loop:
   143→	LD C, (XIY)			; color = page_bitmap_0[y][x]
   144→	LDB (XIX), C			; curPagePtr1[y][x] = color
   145→	INC XIX
   146→	INC XIY
   147→	DJNZ HL, drawLineP_loop
   148→
   149→	POP XHL
   150→	POP XIY
   151→	POP XIX
   152→	RET
   153→
   154→drawLineBlend:
   155→	; Blend: read existing pixel, apply (color & 7) | 8
   156→	PUSH XIX
   157→	PUSH XHL
   158→
   159→	CALL CALC_LINE_XMAX_AND_XMIN
   160→
   161→	; curPagePtr1 scanline pointer
   162→	LD XIX, (CUR_LINE)
   163→	LD HL, (LINE_XMIN)
   164→	EXTS XHL
   165→	ADD XIX, XHL
   166→	LD HL, (LINE_XMAX)
   167→	SUB HL, (LINE_XMIN)
   168→
   169→drawLineBlend_loop:
   170→	LD C, (XIX)			; color = curPagePtr1[y][x]
   171→	ANDB C, 07h			; color &= 0x07
   172→	ORB C, 08h			; color |= 0x08
   173→	LDB (XIX), C			; curPagePtr1[y][x] = blended color
   174→	INC XIX
   175→	DJNZ HL, drawLineBlend_loop
   176→
   177→	POP XHL
   178→	POP XIX
   179→	RET
   180→
   181→drawPoint:
   182→	PUSH XIX
   183→	LD WA, 0
   184→	LD WA, HL
   185→	MUL XWA, 320
   186→	; FIXME: do we need to zero the upper 16 bits of XDE here?
   187→	ADD XWA, XDE
   188→	LD XIX, 01a0000h
   189→	ADD XIX, XWA
   190→	LD (XIX), BC
   191→	POP XIX
   192→	RET

   213→BREAK:
   214→	; This is a temporary placeholder
   215→	; while we still do not emulate
   216→	; the VM thread execution
   217→
   218→	LD A, 0FEh		; end-of-frame
   219→	CALL UPDATE_DISPLAY
   220→	CALL PAUSE
   221→	RET

   223→
   224→UPDATE_DISPLAY:
   225→	; A: PageID
   226→	CP A, 0FEh
   227→	JP EQ, _UPDATE_DISPLAY
   228→
   229→	CP A, 0FFh
   230→	JP EQ, _UPDATE_DISPLAY_PAGEID_FF
   231→
   232→_UPDATE_DISPLAY_PAGEID_NOT_FE_OR_FF:
   233→	CALL GET_PAGE_PTR
   234→	LD (CUR_PAGE_PTR_2), XWA
   235→	JP _UPDATE_DISPLAY
   236→	
   237→_UPDATE_DISPLAY_PAGEID_FF:
   238→	LD XIY, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_2)
   239→	LD XWA, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_3)
   240→	LD (CUR_PAGE_PTR_2), XWA
   241→	LD (CUR_PAGE_PTR_3), XIY
   242→
   243→_UPDATE_DISPLAY:
   244→	LD XHL, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_2)
   245→	LD XDE, 001a0000h + 20*320	; vga memory, skipping the first 20 lines because the image has 320x200 resolution and the screen has 320x240
   246→	LD XBC, 320 * 200 / 2		; bitmap data length in 16-bit words (320x200 pixels)
   247→	LDIRW
   248→	RET

   251→VIDEO_START:
   252→	LD XIX, PAGE_BITMAP_2
   253→	LD (CUR_PAGE_PTR_1), XIX
   254→	LD (CUR_PAGE_PTR_2), XIX
   255→	LD XIX, PAGE_BITMAP_1
   256→	LD (CUR_PAGE_PTR_3), XIX

   259→; initForPart: Reset all threads and prepare for a new game part
   260→; Input: WA = partId
   261→initForPart:
   262→	LD (CURRENT_PART_ID), WA
   263→
   264→	; Reset VM state
   265→	LD XIX, VM_STACK
   266→	LD (VM_STACK_POINTER), XIX
   267→
   268→	; Reset all threads: inactive and unfrozen
   269→	LD IX, 0
   270→_initForPart_loop:
   271→	PUSH IX
   272→	SLA 2, IX
   273→	EXTZ XIX
   274→	ADD XIX, THREADS_DATA
   275→	LDW (XIX + PC_OFFSET), INACTIVE_THREAD
   276→	LDW (XIX + REQUESTED_PC_OFFSET), NO_REQUEST
   277→	POP IX
   278→
   279→	PUSH IX
   280→	SLA 1, IX
   281→	EXTZ XIX
   282→	ADD XIX, VM_IS_CHANNEL_ACTIVE
   283→	LD (XIX + CURRENT_STATE), NOT_FROZEN
   284→	LD (XIX + REQUESTED_STATE), NO_STATE_REQUEST
   285→	POP IX
   286→
   287→	INC IX
   288→	CP IX, 64
   289→	JP NE, _initForPart_loop
   290→
   291→	; Start thread 0 at PC=0
   292→	LDW (THREADS_DATA + PC_OFFSET), 0
   293→
   294→	; Set variable 0xE4 = 0x14 (as per reference)
   295→	LD A, 0E4h
   296→	LD DE, 014h
   297→	CALL _write_vm_var
   298→
   299→	; Note: Full part switching would require bank-switching bytecode,
   300→	; palettes, and video data. Only intro resources are available.
   301→	RET
   302→
   303→
   304→GAME_RESET:
   305→	CALL VIDEO_START
   306→
   307→	; Zero all VM variables (256 x 16-bit = 512 bytes)
   308→	LD XDE, VM_VARIABLES
   309→	LD WA, 0
   310→	LD BC, 256
   311→_zero_vars_loop:
   312→	LD (XDE), WA
   313→	INC 2, XDE
   314→	DJNZ BC, _zero_vars_loop
   315→
   316→	LDB (CURRENT_THREAD), 0
   317→	LDW (VM_PC), 0
   318→	LD XIX, VM_STACK
   319→	LD (VM_STACK_POINTER), XIX
   320→
   321→	; All threads are initially disabled and unfrozen
   322→	LD IX, 0
   323→_setup_threads__loop:
   324→
   325→	PUSH IX
   326→	SLA 2, IX
   327→	EXTZ XIX
   328→	ADD XIX, THREADS_DATA
   329→	LDW (XIX + PC_OFFSET), INACTIVE_THREAD
   330→	LDW (XIX + REQUESTED_PC_OFFSET), NO_REQUEST
   331→	POP IX
   332→
   333→	PUSH IX
   334→	SLA 1, IX
   335→	EXTZ XIX
   336→	ADD XIX, VM_IS_CHANNEL_ACTIVE
   337→	LD (XIX + CURRENT_STATE), NOT_FROZEN
   338→	LD (XIX + REQUESTED_STATE), NO_STATE_REQUEST
   339→	POP IX
   340→
   341→	INC IX
   342→	CP IX, 64
   343→	JP NE, _setup_threads__loop
   344→
   345→	; Start thread 0 at PC=0 (matching initForPart behavior)
   346→	LDW (THREADS_DATA + PC_OFFSET), 0
   347→
   348→	; Initialize VM_VARIABLE_RANDOM_SEED with a fixed seed (no RTC available)
   349→	LD A, VM_VARIABLE_RANDOM_SEED
   350→	LD DE, 1234h			; Fixed seed value
   351→	CALL _write_vm_var
   352→
   353→	; VM_HACK_INIT_VAR_54_WITH_81: Required for Interplay logo display
   354→	LD A, 054h
   355→	LD DE, 0081h
   356→	CALL _write_vm_var
   357→
   358→	; Initialize part tracking
   359→	LDW (REQUESTED_NEXT_PART), 0
   360→	LDW (CURRENT_PART_ID), GAME_PART_INTRO
   361→
   362→	RET

   391→readAndDrawPolygon:

   394→	; DE: x

   397→	; C: zoom (default = 40h)
   398→	PUSH DE
   399→	PUSH HL
   400→	PUSH BC

   402→	LD A, (XIX)
   403→	INC XIX
   404→	CP A, 0C0H
   405→	JP ULT, VALUE_IS_LT_C0

   408→
   409→	CP B, 128
   410→	JP ULT, COLOR_BIT_7_IS_OFF
   411→	LD B, A
   412→	ANDB B, 03Fh				;	if (color & 0x80) color = i & 0x3F;
   413→COLOR_BIT_7_IS_OFF:
   414→	
   415→	;(&m_polygonData[m_data_offset], zoom);

   426→	PUSH XIX

   448→	LD WA, 0

   461→	LD E, C

   502→	; HL: y

   642→	; CUR_LINE = CUR_PAGE_PTR_1 + HLINEY * 320 (signed multiply for negative HLINEY)
   643→	LD WA, (HLINEY)
   644→	EXTS XWA			; sign-extend HLINEY to 32 bits
   645→	LD DE, 320
   646→	MULS XWA, DE		; XWA = HLINEY * 320 (signed)
   647→	LD XIX, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_1)
   648→	ADD XIX, XWA
   649→	LD (CUR_LINE), XIX
   650→
   651→	POP XIY
   652→	POP XIX
   653→	POP XHL ; RESTORE DRAW_FUNC_PTR
   654→
   655→	INC 4, XIX		; 	i++;
   656→	DEC 4, XIY		; 	j--;
   657→
   658→	LDW (CPT1_LOW), 07FFFh		; 	cpt1 = (cpt1 & 0xFFFF0000) | 0x7FFF;
   659→	LDW (CPT2_LOW), 08000h		; 	cpt2 = (cpt2 & 0xFFFF0000) | 0x8000;
   660→
   661→	CPW (POLYGON_H), 0
   662→	JP Z, POLYGON_H_IS_ZERO
   663→	
   664→FOR_H_LOOP:			; for (; h != 0; --h)
   665→	CPW (HLINEY), 0
   666→	JP LT, AFTER_DRAWFUNC_CALL
   667→
   668→	LD WA, (CPT1_HIGH)		; x1 = cpt1 >> 16;
   669→	LD (X1), WA
   670→
   671→	LD WA, (CPT2_HIGH)		; x2 = cpt2 >> 16;
   672→	LD (X2), WA
   673→
   674→
   675→	; if (x1 < 320 && x2 >= 0)
   676→	CPW (X1), 320
   677→	JP GE, AFTER_DRAWFUNC_CALL
   678→	CPW (X2), 0
   679→	JP LT, AFTER_DRAWFUNC_CALL
   680→
   681→	;	if (x1 < 0) x1 = 0;
   682→	CPW (X1), 0
   683→	JP GE, X1_NOT_NEGATIVE	
   684→	LDW (X1), 0
   685→X1_NOT_NEGATIVE:
   686→
   687→	;   if (x2 > 319) x2 = 319;
   688→	CPW (X2), 319
   689→	JP LE, X2_LESS_THAN_SCREEN_W
   690→	LDW (X2), 319
   691→X2_LESS_THAN_SCREEN_W:
   692→	
   693→	;(x1, x2, color);
   694→	CALL (XHL) ; drawfunc
   695→
   696→AFTER_DRAWFUNC_CALL:
   697→
   698→	LD WA, (STEP1_LOW)
   699→	ADD (CPT1_LOW), WA
   700→	LD WA, (STEP1_HIGH)
   701→	ADC (CPT1_HIGH), WA	; 	cpt1 += step1;
   702→
   703→	LD WA, (STEP2_LOW)
   704→	ADD (CPT2_LOW), WA
   705→	LD WA, (STEP2_HIGH)
   706→	ADC (CPT2_HIGH), WA	; 	cpt2 += step2;
   707→
   708→	INCW (HLINEY)
   709→
   710→	; Advance CUR_LINE by 320 unconditionally (even for skipped scanlines)
   711→	ADDW (CUR_LINE_LOW), 320
   712→	ADCW (CUR_LINE_HIGH), 0
   713→
   714→	CPW (HLINEY), 199
   715→	JP GT, POLYGON_RASTER_LOOP	; if (m_hliney > 199) return; (signed comparison)
   716→
   717→	DECW (POLYGON_H)
   718→	JP NZ, FOR_H_LOOP
   719→
   720→	JP POLYGON_RASTER_LOOP
   721→
   722→POLYGON_H_IS_ZERO:
   723→	LD WA, (STEP1_LOW)
   724→	ADD (CPT1_LOW), WA
   725→	LD WA, (STEP1_HIGH)
   726→	ADC (CPT1_HIGH), WA	; 	cpt1 += step1;
   727→	
   728→	LD WA, (STEP2_LOW)
   729→	ADD (CPT2_LOW), WA
   730→	LD WA, (STEP2_HIGH)
   731→	ADC (CPT2_HIGH), WA	; 	cpt2 += step2;
   732→
   733→	JP POLYGON_RASTER_LOOP

   740→calcStep:
   741→	; Inputs:
   742→	; XHL = ptr to STEP_1 or STEP_2
   743→	; XIX = p1
   744→	; XIY = p2
   745→
   746→	PUSHW 4000h		; uint16_t v = 0x4000;
   747→
   748→	LD WA, (XIY)
   749→	LD (DX), WA		; dx = p2.x
   750→
   751→	LD WA, (XIX)
   752→	SUB (DX), WA		; dx -= p1.x;
   753→
   754→	INC 2, XIX
   755→	INC 2, XIY
   756→	
   757→	LD WA, (XIY)
   758→	LD (POLYGON_H), WA		; dy = p2.y
   759→
   760→	LD WA, (XIX)
   761→	SUB (POLYGON_H), WA		; dy -= p1.y
   762→
   763→	CPW (POLYGON_H), 0
   764→	JP LE, POLYGON_H_IS_LE_ZERO  ; if (dy>0)
   765→	
   766→	LD WA, (XSP)
   767→	EXTS XWA
   768→	LD DE, (POLYGON_H)
   769→	DIV XWA, DE
   770→	LD (XSP), WA			; v = 0x4000/(POLYGON_H)
   771→
   772→POLYGON_H_IS_LE_ZERO:
   773→	
   774→	LD WA, (DX)
   775→	EXTS XWA
   776→
   777→	LD DE, (XSP)		; v
   778→	MULS XWA, DE
   779→	SLA 2, XWA
   780→	LD (XHL), XWA		; return dx * v * 4
   781→
   782→	INC 2, XSP
   783→	RET

   786→readAndDrawPolygonHierarchy:
   787→	LD D, 0
   788→	LD E, C ; zoom
   789→	;	pt.x -= m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] * zoom / DEFAULT_ZOOM;
   790→	LD WA, 0
   791→	LD A, (XIX)
   792→	INC XIX
   793→	LD HL, (XSP + 6)
   794→	MUL XWA, DE			; PT.X *= ZOOM
   795→	SRA 6, WA			; PT.X /= default_zoom (40h)
   796→	SUB HL, WA
   797→	LD (XSP + 6), HL
   798→
   799→	;	pt.y -= m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] * zoom / DEFAULT_ZOOM;
   800→	LD WA, 0
   801→	LD A, (XIX)
   802→	INC XIX
   803→	LD HL, (XSP + 4)
   804→	MUL XWA, DE			; PT.Y *= ZOOM
   805→	SRA 6, WA			; PT.Y /= default_zoom (40h)
   806→	SUB HL, WA
   807→	LD (XSP + 4), HL
   808→
   809→	ld B, 0
   810→	LD C, (XIX)		; num_children - 1
   811→	INC XIX
   812→	INC BC			; BC = num_children
   813→
   814→children_loop:
   815→	LD WA, (XIX); offset 
   816→	INC 2, XIX
   817→	EX W, A
   818→	PUSH WA
   819→	PUSHW (XSP + 8); po.x = pt.x
   820→	PUSHW (XSP + 8); po.y = pt.y
   821→
   822→	; po.x += m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] * zoom / DEFAULT_ZOOM;
   823→	LD WA, 0
   824→	LD A, (XIX)
   825→	INC XIX
   826→	LD HL, (XSP + 2)
   827→	MUL XWA, DE			; PO.X *= ZOOM
   828→	SRA 6, WA			; PO.X /= default_zoom (40h)
   829→	ADD HL, WA
   830→	LD (XSP + 2), HL
   831→	
   832→	; po.y += m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] * zoom / DEFAULT_ZOOM;
   833→	LD WA, 0
   834→	LD A, (XIX)
   835→	INC XIX
   836→	LD HL, (XSP)
   837→	MUL XWA, DE			; PO.Y *= ZOOM
   838→	SRA 6, WA			; PO.Y /= default_zoom (40h)
   839→	ADD HL, WA
   840→	LD (XSP), HL
   841→
   842→	PUSH DE			; save zoom
   843→	LD DE, 0FFh				; uint16_t color = 0xFF;
   844→	LD HL, (XSP + 6) ;offset
   845→	AND HL, 8000h
   846→	JP Z, OFFSET_BIT15_NOT_SET
   847→	LD DE, 0
   848→	LD E,(XIX)				; 	color = m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] & 0x7F;
   849→	AND E, 7Fh
   850→	INC 2, XIX				; 	m_data_offset++; //and waste a byte...
   851→OFFSET_BIT15_NOT_SET:
   852→
   853→	PUSH XIX			;	 uint16_t backup = m_data_offset;
   854→	LD XIX, 0
   855→	LD IX, (XSP + 0Ah) ;offset
   856→	SLA 1, IX		 ; m_data_offset = (offset & 0x7FFF) * 2;
   857→	ADD XIX, INTRO_VIDEO_1
   858→	
   859→	LD HL, DE
   860→	; here L is the computer new color
   861→	; and BC is the children loop counter
   862→
   863→	; BC needs to become color | zoom params and
   864→	; DE needs to become x param
   865→	; to the readAndDrawPolygon routine
   866→	
   867→	LD DE, (XSP + 4)	; restore zoom
   868→
   869→	PUSH BC
   870→	LD B, L		; color
   871→	LD C, E		; zoom
   872→	LD DE, (XSP + 0ah)		; PO.x
   873→	LD HL, (XSP + 08h)		; PO.y
   874→	; (color, zoom, po)
   875→	CALL readAndDrawPolygon
   876→	POP BC
   877→	POP XIX				; m_data_offset = backup;
   878→	POP DE		; restore zoom
   879→
   880→	ADD XSP, 6 ; local vars offset, po.x, po.y (INC only supports 1,2,4,8)
   881→	DJNZ BC, children_loop
   882→	RET

   893→SETUP_PALETTE:
   894→	; XWA: paletteID
   895→	; Palette format: 2 bytes per color, 0x0RGB (4 bits per channel)
   896→	; Byte 0: 0000_RRRR (low nibble = red)
   897→	; Byte 1: GGGG_BBBB (high nibble = green, low nibble = blue)
   898→	LD BC,0
   899→	LD XDE, 01703c8h		; VGA 3c8 port (select color palette index)
   900→	LD (XDE), C
   901→
   902→	LD BC, 16							; 16 colors per palette
   903→	LD XDE, 01703c9h					; VGA 3c9 port (R, G, B data)
   904→	LD XHL, INTRO_PALETTES
   905→	SLA 5, XWA
   906→	ADD XHL, XWA
   907→
   908→PALETTE_LOOP:
   909→	; red: low nibble of byte 0
   910→	LD A, (XHL)
   911→	AND A, 0Fh
   912→	SLA 2, A			; scale 4-bit (0-15) to 6-bit (0-60) for VGA DAC
   913→	LD (XDE), A
   914→	INC XHL
   915→
   916→	; green: high nibble of byte 1
   917→	LD A, (XHL)
   918→	SRL 4, A			; logical shift right to extract high nibble
   919→	SLA 2, A			; scale 4-bit to 6-bit for VGA DAC
   920→	LD (XDE), A
   921→
   922→	; blue: low nibble of byte 1
   923→	LD A, (XHL)
   924→	AND A, 0Fh
   925→	SLA 2, A			; scale 4-bit to 6-bit for VGA DAC
   926→	LD (XDE), A
   927→	INC XHL
   928→
   929→	DJNZ BC, PALETTE_LOOP
   930→	RET

  1196→FETCH_OPCODE:
  1197→	LD A, (XIX)  ; opcode = fetch_byte();
  1198→	INC XIX
  1199→
  1200→	BIT 7, A	; if (opcode & 0x80)
  1201→	JP Z, OPCODE_BIT_7_NOT_SET
  1202→
  1203→	; ====  VIDEO instruction (0x80) ====
  1204→_OPCODE_0x80:
  1205→;		uint16_t offset = ((opcode << 8) | fetch_byte()) * 2;
  1206→	LD W, A
  1207→	LD A, (XIX)
  1208→	INC XIX
  1209→	PUSH WA				; save offset_raw = (opcode << 8) | low_byte
  1210→
  1211→	; Read x from bytecode (XIX still points to bytecode stream)
  1212→	LD D, 0
  1213→	LD E, (XIX)			; x = fetch_byte()
  1214→	INC XIX
  1215→	PUSH DE				; save x
  1216→
  1217→	; Read y from bytecode
  1218→	LD A, (XIX)			; y = fetch_byte()
  1219→	INC XIX
  1220→	LD H, 0
  1221→	LD L, A				; HL = y
  1222→
  1223→	; Save bytecode position (past all 4 consumed bytes: opcode, offset_lo, x, y)
  1224→	PUSH HL				; save y
  1225→	LD XDE, XIX
  1226→	SUB XDE, INTRO_BYTECODE
  1227→	LD (VM_PC), DE
  1228→	POP HL				; restore y
  1229→
  1230→	; Restore x
  1231→	POP DE				; DE = x
  1232→
  1233→	; Compute offset and set up video data pointer
  1234→	POP WA				; WA = offset_raw

    31→(`another_world_vm.asm:1148-1165`)
    32→
    33→The MOV instruction reads `srcVariableId` and `dstVariableId` but the write at line 1163 writes to `XIY` which still points to `VM_VARIABLES + srcVariableId`, not `dstVariableId`.     34→
    35→#### 2. **Opcode 0x02 (ADD) - BUG: same as MOV, doesn't add**
    36→(`another_world_vm.asm:1168-1186`)
    37→
    38→This is literally a copy of MOV's code. It reads the source value but never adds it to the destination. It should: read dst value, read src value, add them, write back to dst.
    39→
    40→#### 3. **Opcode 0x03 (addConst) - Endianness bug**
    41→(`another_world_vm.asm:1189-1203`)
    42→

But the reference uses big-endian reads (`READ_WORD_AW` = `READ_BYTE(A) << 8 | READ_BYTE(A+1)`), while `LD WA, (XIX)` reads in native little-endian order. The bytecode is big-endian (Amiga/68k origin). **This same endianness issue likely affects all `fetch_word()` operations throughout the code** (opcodes 0x00, 0x03, 0x04, 0x07, 0x08, 0x09, 0x0A, 0x0B, etc.).

    46→(`another_world_vm.asm:1316-1325`)
    47→
    48→This just skips 5 bytes and does nothing. The conditional jump is essential for all game logic (branches, comparisons). Without it, the game can only run linear sequences. The reference has 6 comparison modes (eq, ne, gt, ge, lt, le) plus variable-length operands depending on subopcode bits 6-7.
    49→

    51→(`another_world_vm.asm:1339-1344`)
    52→

    56→(`another_world_vm.asm:1379-1399`)

    61→(`another_world_vm.asm:1427-1431`)
    62→
    63→Doesn't consume its 5 bytes of arguments (word stringId, byte x, byte y, byte color). Will desync the bytecode stream. The DRAW_STRING routine exists but is never called from here.
    64→
    65→#### 8. **Opcode 0x13 (SUB) - NOT IMPLEMENTED**
    66→(`another_world_vm.asm:1434-1439`)
    67→
    68→Doesn't consume its 2 bytes. Will desync.
    69→
    70→#### 9. **Opcode 0x14 (AND) - NOT IMPLEMENTED**
    71→(`another_world_vm.asm:1442-1447`)
    72→
    73→Doesn't consume its 3 bytes. Will desync.
    74→
    75→#### 10. **Opcode 0x15 (OR) - NOT IMPLEMENTED**
    76→(`another_world_vm.asm:1450-1455`)
    77→
    78→Doesn't consume its 3 bytes. Will desync.

    80→#### 11. **Opcode 0x16 (SHL) - NOT IMPLEMENTED**
    81→(`another_world_vm.asm:1458-1463`)
    82→
    83→Doesn't consume its 3 bytes. Will desync.
    84→
    85→#### 12. **Opcode 0x17 (SHR) - NOT IMPLEMENTED**
    86→(`another_world_vm.asm:1466-1471`)
    87→
    88→Doesn't consume its 3 bytes. Will desync.
    89→
    90→#### 13. **Opcode 0x19 (LOAD/updateMemList) - NOT IMPLEMENTED**
    91→(`another_world_vm.asm:1484-1490`)
    92→
    93→Skips the word argument but does nothing. In the reference, this handles:
    94→- `resourceId == 0`: stop all sound
    95→- `resourceId > 0x91`: switch to a new game part (level change)
    96→- Otherwise: load a screen bitmap resource
    97→
    98→#### 14. **Opcode 0x40 (video with extended addressing) - NOT IMPLEMENTED**
    99→(`another_world_vm.asm:1072-1125`)
   100→
   101→The entire opcode 0x40 block is commented out and jumps to end without consuming any bytes. This handles polygon rendering with variable X/Y addressing modes and zoom. It's required for most in-game polygon graphics. **The variable-length encoding means skipping an unknown number of bytes, so this will definitely desync the VM.**

   104→(`another_world_vm.asm:89-102`)

   109→(`another_world_vm.asm:104-117`)

   127→The reference has several critical hacks:
   128→- `VM_HACK_SWITCH_FROM_INTRO_TO_LAKE`: Sets var 0xDC when transitioning from intro
   129→- `VM_HACK_INIT_VAR_54_WITH_81`: Required for the Interplay logo to show

   135→
   136→**Will crash/desync the VM** (bytecode not consumed correctly):
   137→- Opcode 0x0C (resetThread) - missing 3 bytes
   138→- Opcode 0x12 (drawString) - missing 5 bytes
   139→- Opcode 0x13 (SUB) - missing 2 bytes
   140→- Opcode 0x14 (AND) - missing 3 bytes
   141→- Opcode 0x15 (OR) - missing 3 bytes
   142→- Opcode 0x16 (SHL) - missing 3 bytes
   143→- Opcode 0x17 (SHR) - missing 3 bytes
   144→- Opcode 0x40 (video extended) - variable length, unparsed
   145→- Opcode 0x0A (condJmp) - skips 5 bytes, but actual length is variable (5-6 bytes depending on subopcode)

   148→- Opcode 0x01 (MOV) - writes to wrong variable
   149→- Opcode 0x02 (ADD) - doesn't add, just copies (also to wrong dest)
   150→- Big-endian fetch_word not handled (affects most word-reading opcodes)
   151→

   153→- Input handling
   154→- Part/level switching
   155→- Sound (understandable given hardware constraints)
   156→
   157→The port currently can only play the intro cinematic in a linear fashion (no branching, no interaction). To reach "complete and functional" status, the highest priority items would be: fixing the endianness issue, implementing condJmp (0x0A), fixing MOV/ADD, implementing the bytecode-consuming stubs to prevent desync, and then implementing opcode 0x40 for full polygon rendering.

; =============================================================================
; main.asm - Another World VM for KN5000
; =============================================================================
; Unified platform wrapper for dual-target build:
;   - TARGET_MAINCPU: Standalone main CPU ROM (0xE00000, for MAME testing)
;   - TARGET_EXTENSION: HDAE5000 extension board ROM (0x280000)
;

	PUSH XIX

Perfect! Now I have enough context. Let me create a comprehensive analysis document.

## Analysis Report: Another World VM Execution Flow - Bugs Preventing Rendering

Based on my thorough analysis of `/home/fsanches/devel/custom-kn5000-roms/anotherworld/src/another_world_vm.asm`, I've identified multiple critical bugs that prevent any rendering from appearing on screen. Here's a complete breakdown:

---

## 1. ENTRY POINT AND GAME_RESET

**Location:** Lines 364-371, 304-362

The execution flow is correct:
- `ENTRY` calls `GAME_RESET`
- `GAME_RESET` initializes VM state and sets thread 0's PC to 0
- Main loop repeatedly calls `EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION`

**Thread 0 Initial State:**
- PC = 0 (correct)
- All variables zeroed
- Stack initialized

The bytecode at resource-0x18.bin starts with `04 00 e7 00 ff 00 01 08` which decodes as:
- **Opcode 0x04** (CALL): Calls subroutine at address 0x00E7
- This should fill display pages, select a page, and blit to screen

**No bugs found in initialization itself.**

---

## 2. EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION LOOP - CRITICAL BUGS

**Location:** Lines 1188-1260 and beyond

### BUG 2.1: PC Computation at Entry (Line 1192-1194)

```asm
LD IX, (VM_PC)
EXTZ XIX
ADD XIX, INTRO_BYTECODE
```

**Issue:** Uses `EXTZ XIX` which zero-extends the **32-bit register XIX** (not the 16-bit value in IX). This is incorrect - should be:
```asm
LD W, 0
LD A, (CURRENT_THREAD)  ; or just use 16-bit IX directly
```

However, examining the final PC update at line 2151-2152:
```asm
SUB XIX, INTRO_BYTECODE
LD (VM_PC), IX
```

This **overwrites VM_PC with IX**, which was set from `(VM_PC)` at line 1192. So if XIX has garbage in the upper 16 bits, and we subtract INTRO_BYTECODE (a 24-bit address), the result placed into IX will be **garbage**. This corrupts PC for the next instruction.

**But wait** - examining actual bytecode offsets: the bytecode at resource-0x18.bin is embedded at label `INTRO_BYTECODE` which is a fixed 24-bit address. The PC values (0, 3, etc.) are small 16-bit offsets that fit in IX. The `SUB XIX, INTRO_BYTECODE` on line 2151 should correctly give the offset.

**Actual issue:** The `EXTZ XIX` on line 1193 doesn't actually harm anything if we're only using the lower 16 bits of XIX subsequently. But it's semantically wrong and could be a source of subtle issues.

### BUG 2.2: PC Calculation Bug - XIX vs IX Mismatch (Line 2151-2152)

This is the **most critical rendering bug**:

```asm
_end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION:
    SUB XIX, INTRO_BYTECODE
    LD (VM_PC), IX            ; <-- BUG: writing IX, not result of subtraction
```

**The problem:** 
- XIX is the bytecode pointer (after instruction execution)
- The subtraction `SUB XIX, INTRO_BYTECODE` computes the new offset
- But then **`LD (VM_PC), IX`** writes the OLD value of IX (the original PC) instead of the computed offset from XIX

This means **every instruction advances XIX but doesn't update VM_PC correctly**. The next instruction will use the same PC again, creating an **infinite loop on the first instruction**.

**Wait, let me re-examine:** Looking at line 1192:
```asm
LD IX, (VM_PC)
EXTZ XIX
ADD XIX, INTRO_BYTECODE
```

Actually `EXTZ XIX` zero-extends the **32-bit XIX register**, not loading from (VM_PC). So XIX is not set from (VM_PC). This is bizarre. Let me trace through more carefully:

Looking at the actual code again:
```asm
EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION:
    PUSH XIX
    PUSH XIY
    
    LD IX, (VM_PC)           ; IX = 16-bit offset
    EXTZ XIX                 ; Clear upper bits of XIX (why?)
    ADD XIX, INTRO_BYTECODE  ; XIX now has garbage in upper 16 bits + lower 16 bits = partial address
```

The `EXTZ XIX` is **wrong** - it should be `EXTZ XIY` or `EXTZ XWA` or something. Since XIX was just pushed and we only use its lower 16 bits for addition, the upper bits being non-zero doesn't matter for the add, but the variable is semantically wrong.

**But the real rendering bug:** At line 2151, after computing the new XIX offset:
```asm
SUB XIX, INTRO_BYTECODE    ; XIX = new offset
LD (VM_PC), IX             ; Write old IX (not the new offset!)
```

This writes the **old** IX value, not the result of the subtraction. It should be:
```asm
LD IX, XIX          ; Move XIX result to IX
SUB XIX, INTRO_BYTECODE
LD (VM_PC), IX)
```

Or more simply, use the result of XIX subtraction. **This completely breaks bytecode PC tracking**, causing all subsequent instructions to decode from wrong positions or hang in loops.

---

## 3. BLITFRAMEBUFFER (Opcode 0x10) - Rendering Path

**Location:** Lines 1917-1941

```asm
; ====  BLIT_FRAMEBUFFER instruction  ====
CP A, 10h
JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_BLIT_FRAMEBUFFER
LD A, (XIX)        ; byte pageId
INC XIX
; ... hack check ...
POP WA             ; restore pageId
CALL UPDATE_DISPLAY
CALL PAUSE
JP _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION
```

**Calls `UPDATE_DISPLAY` at line 1938.** Let's check that:

---

## 4. UPDATE_DISPLAY ROUTINE

**Location:** Lines 224-248

```asm
UPDATE_DISPLAY:
    ; A: PageID
    CP A, 0FEh
    JP EQ, _UPDATE_DISPLAY
    
    CP A, 0FFh
    JP EQ, _UPDATE_DISPLAY_PAGEID_FF
    
_UPDATE_DISPLAY_PAGEID_NOT_FE_OR_FF:
    CALL GET_PAGE_PTR
    LD (CUR_PAGE_PTR_2), XWA
    JP _UPDATE_DISPLAY
    
_UPDATE_DISPLAY_PAGEID_FF:
    LD XIY, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_2)
    LD XWA, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_3)
    LD (CUR_PAGE_PTR_2), XWA
    LD (CUR_PAGE_PTR_3), XIY
    
_UPDATE_DISPLAY:
    LD XHL, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_2)
    LD XDE, 001a0000h + 20*320    ; vga memory @ 0x1A0000, skip 20 lines
    LD XBC, 320 * 200 / 2         ; copy 320x200 = 32,000 pixels (16,000 words)
    LDIRW                          ; Copy 16-bit words
    RET
```

	SLA 2, IX
	EXTZ XIX
	ADD XIX, THREADS_DATA

content.text:
Found the root cause. `GET_PAGE_PTR` for page IDs 0-3 uses `LD QWA, WA` (copies to previous register bank) followed by `LD WA, 0` and `ADD XWA, PAGE_BITMAP_0`. This leaves the upper 16 bits of XWA undefined, so the computed page address is garbage. **All pages 0-3 point to wrong memory.**

This explains the grey screen — fillVideoPage, selectVideoPage, and blitFramebuffer all get wrong addresses for named pages.

Let me fix it with a simple compare-and-branch for the 4 page IDs:

	POP HL
	POP DE
	RET

readVertices:
	PUSH XIX
	PUSH DE
	PUSH HL
	PUSH BC

	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD DE, 0
	LD E, C
	MUL XWA, DE			; *= ZOOM
	SRAW 6, WA			; /= default_zoom (40h)
	LD (POLYGON_BBOX_W), WA

	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD DE, 0
	LD E, C
	MUL XWA, DE			; *= ZOOM
	SRAW 6, WA			; /= default_zoom (40h)
	LD (POLYGON_BBOX_H), WA

	LD B, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD (POLYGON_NUM_POINTS), B

	LD XIY, POLYGON_POINTS
	LD DE, 0
	LD E, C

READ_THE_COORDINATES:

	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	MUL XWA, DE			; *= ZOOM
	SRAW 6, WA			; /= default_zoom (40h)
	LD (XIY), WA
	INC 2, XIY

	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	MUL XWA, DE			; *= ZOOM
	SRAW 6, WA			; /= default_zoom (40h)
	LD (XIY), WA
	INC 2, XIY

	DJNZ B, READ_THE_COORDINATES	

	POP BC
	POP HL
	POP DE
	POP XIX	
	RET

fillPolygon:
	; DE: x
	; HL: y
	; B: color (Black = FFh)

	PUSH BC
	LD C, B
	LD B, 0

	;if (m_polygon.bbox_w == 0 && m_polygon.bbox_h == 1 && m_polygon.numPoints == 4)
	CPW (POLYGON_BBOX_W), 0
	JP NZ, NOT_A_POINT
	CPW (POLYGON_BBOX_H), 1
	JP NZ, NOT_A_POINT
	CP (POLYGON_NUM_POINTS), 4
	JP NZ, NOT_A_POINT
	
	;(color, pt.x, pt.y);
	CALL drawPoint
	JP end_of_fillPolygon
	
	NOT_A_POINT:

	PUSH IX
	; int16_t xmin = pt.x - m_polygon.bbox_w / 2;
	LD IX, (POLYGON_BBOX_W)
	SRA 1, IX
	LD (POLYGON_XMIN), DE
	SUB (POLYGON_XMIN), IX

	; int16_t xmax = pt.x + m_polygon.bbox_w / 2;
	LD (POLYGON_XMAX), DE
	ADD (POLYGON_XMAX), IX

	; int16_t ymin = pt.y - m_polygon.bbox_h / 2;
	LD IX, (POLYGON_BBOX_H)
	SRA 1, IX
	LD (POLYGON_YMIN), HL
	SUB (POLYGON_YMIN), IX

	; int16_t ymax = pt.y + m_polygon.bbox_h / 2;	
	LD (POLYGON_YMAX), HL
	ADD (POLYGON_YMAX), IX
	POP IX


	;if (xmin >= 320 || xmax < 0 || ymin >= 200 || ymax < 0)
	;	return;
	CPW (POLYGON_XMIN), 320
	JP GE, end_of_fillPolygon
	CPW (POLYGON_XMAX), 0
	JP LT, end_of_fillPolygon
	CPW (POLYGON_YMIN), 200
	JP GE, end_of_fillPolygon
	CPW (POLYGON_YMAX), 0
	JP LT, end_of_fillPolygon


	LD WA, (POLYGON_YMIN)
	LD (HLINEY), WA

	LD XIX, POLYGON_POINTS				; i = 0;
	LD XIY, POLYGON_POINTS
	LD XWA, 0
	LD A, (POLYGON_NUM_POINTS)
	DEC A
	SLA 2, XWA
	ADD XIY, XWA						; j = m_polygon.numPoints - 1;

	; x2 = m_polygon.points[i].x + xmin;
	LD WA, (XIX)
	ADD WA, (POLYGON_XMIN)
	LD (X2), WA

	; x1 = m_polygon.points[j].x + xmin;
	LD WA, (XIY)
	ADD WA, (POLYGON_XMIN)
	LD (X1), WA

	INC 4, XIX		; 	i++;
	DEC 4, XIY		; 	j--;


	CP C, 10h
	JP Z, BLEND
	JP UGT, LINE_P

	LD XHL, drawLineN	; 	drawFct = &another_world_vm_state::drawLineN;
	JP AFTER_SETTING_DRAW_CALLBACK

	LINE_P:
	LD XHL, drawLineP	; 	drawFct = &another_world_vm_state::drawLineP;
	JP AFTER_SETTING_DRAW_CALLBACK

	BLEND:
	LD XHL, drawLineBlend

AFTER_SETTING_DRAW_CALLBACK:

	; uint32_t cpt1 = ((uint32_t) x1) << 16;
	LD WA, (X1)
	EXTS XWA
	SLA 16, XWA
	LD (CPT1), XWA

	; uint32_t cpt2 = ((uint32_t) x2) << 16;
	LD WA, (X2)
	EXTS XWA
	SLA 16, XWA
	LD (CPT2), XWA

POLYGON_RASTER_LOOP:
	DEC 2, (POLYGON_NUM_POINTS)

	CP (POLYGON_NUM_POINTS), 0
	JP Z, end_of_fillPolygon		; 	if (m_polygon.numPoints == 0) break;


	; 	int32_t step1 = calcStep(m_polygon.points[j + 1], m_polygon.points[j], h);
	PUSH XHL ; SAVE DRAW_FUNC_PTR
	PUSH XIX
	PUSH XIY
	
	; pt1 = j+1 / pt2 = j
	LD XIX, XIY
	INC 4, XIX
	LD XHL, STEP1
	CALL calcStep

	POP XIY
	POP XIX

	; 	int32_t step2 = calcStep(m_polygon.points[i - 1], m_polygon.points[i], h);
	PUSH XIX
	PUSH XIY

	; pt1 = i-1 / pt2 = i
	LD XIY, XIX
	DEC 4, XIX
	LD XHL, STEP2
	CALL calcStep

	; CUR_LINE = CUR_PAGE_PTR_1 + HLINEY * 320 (signed multiply for negative HLINEY)
	LD WA, (HLINEY)
	EXTS XWA			; sign-extend HLINEY to 32 bits
	LD DE, 320
	MULS XWA, DE		; XWA = HLINEY * 320 (signed)
	LD XIX, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_1)
	ADD XIX, XWA
	LD (CUR_LINE), XIX

	POP XIY
	POP XIX
	POP XHL ; RESTORE DRAW_FUNC_PTR

	INC 4, XIX		; 	i++;
	DEC 4, XIY		; 	j--;

	LDW (CPT1_LOW), 07FFFh		; 	cpt1 = (cpt1 & 0xFFFF0000) | 0x7FFF;
	LDW (CPT2_LOW), 08000h		; 	cpt2 = (cpt2 & 0xFFFF0000) | 0x8000;

	CPW (POLYGON_H), 0
	JP Z, POLYGON_H_IS_ZERO
	
FOR_H_LOOP:			; for (; h != 0; --h)
	CPW (HLINEY), 0
	JP LT, AFTER_DRAWFUNC_CALL

	LD WA, (CPT1_HIGH)		; x1 = cpt1 >> 16;
	LD (X1), WA

	LD WA, (CPT2_HIGH)		; x2 = cpt2 >> 16;
	LD (X2), WA


	; if (x1 < 320 && x2 >= 0)
	CPW (X1), 320
	JP GE, AFTER_DRAWFUNC_CALL
	CPW (X2), 0
	JP LT, AFTER_DRAWFUNC_CALL

	;	if (x1 < 0) x1 = 0;
	CPW (X1), 0
	JP GE, X1_NOT_NEGATIVE	
	LDW (X1), 0
X1_NOT_NEGATIVE:

	;   if (x2 > 319) x2 = 319;
	CPW (X2), 319
	JP LE, X2_LESS_THAN_SCREEN_W
	LDW (X2), 319
X2_LESS_THAN_SCREEN_W:
	
	;(x1, x2, color);
	CALL (XHL) ; drawfunc

AFTER_DRAWFUNC_CALL:

	LD WA, (STEP1_LOW)
	ADD (CPT1_LOW), WA
	LD WA, (STEP1_HIGH)
	ADC (CPT1_HIGH), WA	; 	cpt1 += step1;

	LD WA, (STEP2_LOW)
	ADD (CPT2_LOW), WA
	LD WA, (STEP2_HIGH)
	ADC (CPT2_HIGH), WA	; 	cpt2 += step2;

	INCW (HLINEY)

	; Advance CUR_LINE by 320 unconditionally (even for skipped scanlines)
	ADDW (CUR_LINE_LOW), 320
	ADCW (CUR_LINE_HIGH), 0

	CPW (HLINEY), 199
	JP GT, POLYGON_RASTER_LOOP	; if (m_hliney > 199) return; (signed comparison)

	DECW (POLYGON_H)
	JP NZ, FOR_H_LOOP

	JP POLYGON_RASTER_LOOP

POLYGON_H_IS_ZERO:
	LD WA, (STEP1_LOW)
	ADD (CPT1_LOW), WA
	LD WA, (STEP1_HIGH)
	ADC (CPT1_HIGH), WA	; 	cpt1 += step1;
	
	LD WA, (STEP2_LOW)
	ADD (CPT2_LOW), WA
	LD WA, (STEP2_HIGH)
	ADC (CPT2_HIGH), WA	; 	cpt2 += step2;

	JP POLYGON_RASTER_LOOP

end_of_fillPolygon:
	POP BC
	RET


calcStep:
	; Inputs:
	; XHL = ptr to STEP_1 or STEP_2
	; XIX = p1
	; XIY = p2

	PUSHW 4000h		; uint16_t v = 0x4000;

	LD WA, (XIY)
	LD (DX), WA		; dx = p2.x

	LD WA, (XIX)
	SUB (DX), WA		; dx -= p1.x;

	INC 2, XIX
	INC 2, XIY
	
	LD WA, (XIY)
	LD (POLYGON_H), WA		; dy = p2.y

	LD WA, (XIX)
	SUB (POLYGON_H), WA		; dy -= p1.y

	CPW (POLYGON_H), 0
	JP LE, POLYGON_H_IS_LE_ZERO  ; if (dy>0)
	
	LD WA, (XSP)
	EXTS XWA
	LD DE, (POLYGON_H)
	DIV XWA, DE
	LD (XSP), WA			; v = 0x4000/(POLYGON_H)

POLYGON_H_IS_LE_ZERO:
	
	LD WA, (DX)
	EXTS XWA

	LD DE, (XSP)		; v
	MULS XWA, DE
	SLA 2, XWA
	LD (XHL), XWA		; return dx * v * 4

	INC 2, XSP
	RET


readAndDrawPolygonHierarchy:
	LD D, 0
	LD E, C ; zoom
	;	pt.x -= m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] * zoom / DEFAULT_ZOOM;
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD HL, (XSP + 6)
	MUL XWA, DE			; PT.X *= ZOOM
	SRA 6, WA			; PT.X /= default_zoom (40h)
	SUB HL, WA
	LD (XSP + 6), HL

	;	pt.y -= m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] * zoom / DEFAULT_ZOOM;
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD HL, (XSP + 4)
	MUL XWA, DE			; PT.Y *= ZOOM
	SRA 6, WA			; PT.Y /= default_zoom (40h)
	SUB HL, WA
	LD (XSP + 4), HL

	ld B, 0
	LD C, (XIX)		; num_children - 1
	INC XIX
	INC BC			; BC = num_children

children_loop:
	LD WA, (XIX); offset 
	INC 2, XIX
	EX W, A
	PUSH WA
	PUSHW (XSP + 8); po.x = pt.x
	PUSHW (XSP + 8); po.y = pt.y

	; po.x += m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] * zoom / DEFAULT_ZOOM;
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD HL, (XSP + 2)
	MUL XWA, DE			; PO.X *= ZOOM
	SRA 6, WA			; PO.X /= default_zoom (40h)
	ADD HL, WA
	LD (XSP + 2), HL
	
	; po.y += m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] * zoom / DEFAULT_ZOOM;
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD HL, (XSP)
	MUL XWA, DE			; PO.Y *= ZOOM
	SRA 6, WA			; PO.Y /= default_zoom (40h)
	ADD HL, WA
	LD (XSP), HL

	PUSH DE			; save zoom
	LD DE, 0FFh				; uint16_t color = 0xFF;
	LD HL, (XSP + 6) ;offset
	AND HL, 8000h
	JP Z, OFFSET_BIT15_NOT_SET
	LD DE, 0
	LD E,(XIX)				; 	color = m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] & 0x7F;
	AND E, 7Fh
	INC 2, XIX				; 	m_data_offset++; //and waste a byte...
OFFSET_BIT15_NOT_SET:

	PUSH XIX			;	 uint16_t backup = m_data_offset;
	LD XIX, 0
	LD IX, (XSP + 0Ah) ;offset
	SLA 1, IX		 ; m_data_offset = (offset & 0x7FFF) * 2;
	ADD XIX, INTRO_VIDEO_1
	
	LD HL, DE
	; here L is the computer new color
	; and BC is the children loop counter

	; BC needs to become color | zoom params and
	; DE needs to become x param
	; to the readAndDrawPolygon routine
	
	LD DE, (XSP + 4)	; restore zoom

	PUSH BC
	LD B, L		; color
	LD C, E		; zoom
	LD DE, (XSP + 0ah)		; PO.x
	LD HL, (XSP + 08h)		; PO.y
	; (color, zoom, po)
	CALL readAndDrawPolygon
	POP BC
	POP XIX				; m_data_offset = backup;
	POP DE		; restore zoom

	ADD XSP, 6 ; local vars offset, po.x, po.y (INC only supports 1,2,4,8)
	DJNZ BC, children_loop
	RET


LOAD_SCREEN:
; Input: XHL = pointer to screen bitmap data (320x200 pixels)
; Copies bitmap data to PAGE_BITMAP_0
	LD XDE, PAGE_BITMAP_0
	LD XBC, 320 * 200 / 2		; bitmap data length in 16-bit words (320x200 pixels)
	LDIRW
	RET

SETUP_PALETTE:
	; XWA: paletteID
	; Palette format: 2 bytes per color, 0x0RGB (4 bits per channel)
	; Byte 0: 0000_RRRR (low nibble = red)
	; Byte 1: GGGG_BBBB (high nibble = green, low nibble = blue)
	LD BC,0
	LD XDE, 01703c8h		; VGA 3c8 port (select color palette index)
	LD (XDE), C

	LD BC, 16							; 16 colors per palette
	LD XDE, 01703c9h					; VGA 3c9 port (R, G, B data)
	LD XHL, INTRO_PALETTES
	SLA 5, XWA
	ADD XHL, XWA

PALETTE_LOOP:
	; red: low nibble of byte 0
	LD A, (XHL)
	AND A, 0Fh
	SLA 2, A			; scale 4-bit (0-15) to 6-bit (0-60) for VGA DAC
	LD (XDE), A
	INC XHL

	; green: high nibble of byte 1
	LD A, (XHL)
	SRL 4, A			; logical shift right to extract high nibble
	SLA 2, A			; scale 4-bit to 6-bit for VGA DAC
	LD (XDE), A

	; blue: low nibble of byte 1
	LD A, (XHL)
	AND A, 0Fh
	SLA 2, A			; scale 4-bit to 6-bit for VGA DAC
	LD (XDE), A
	INC XHL

	DJNZ BC, PALETTE_LOOP
	RET


DRAW_STRING:
; WA: stringId
; DE: x
; HL: y
; B: color

	DEC DE
	SLA 3, DE 	;	x = 8 * (x-1);
	LDW (STRING_X0), DE	;	uint16_t x0 = x;
	LD XIX, STRING_INDEX
	EXTS XWA
	ADD XIX, XWA
	ADD XIX, XWA
	LD IX, (XIX)
	EXTS XIX
	ADD XIX, STRING_DATA
	LD C, (XIX)
	INC XIX

DRAW_STRING_LOOP:
	CP C, 0
	RET Z		;	for (; *c != '\0'; c++)

	CP C, 10	;		if (*c == '\n')
	JP NE, NOT_A_LINE_BREAK

LINE_BREAK:
	INC 8, HL			; y+=8;
	LD DE, (STRING_X0)	; x=x0;
	LD C, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	JP DRAW_STRING_LOOP

NOT_A_LINE_BREAK:
	CALL DRAW_CHAR
	INC 8, DE		; x+=8
	LD C, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	JP DRAW_STRING_LOOP


DRAW_CHAR:
	; DE: x
	; HL: y
	; B: color
	; C: character

	LD WA, 0
	LD A, C
	SUB A, 020h
	EXTS XWA
	SLA 3, XWA
	LD XIY, BITMAP_FONT
	ADD XIY, XWA

	PUSH XIX
	PUSH XHL
	PUSH BC

	EXTS XDE
	EXTS XHL

	LD XIX, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_1)
	MUL XHL, 320
	ADD XIX, XHL
	ADD XIX, XDE

	LD WA, 8
DRAW_CHAR_J_LOOP:
	LD C, (XIY)
	INC XIY			; uint8_t row = font[(character - ' ') * 8 + j];

	LD QWA, 8
DRAW_CHAR_I_LOOP:
	SLA 1, C
	JP NC, DONT_PLOT_THIS_PIXEL
	LD (XIX), B
DONT_PLOT_THIS_PIXEL:
	INC XIX
	DJNZ QWA, DRAW_CHAR_I_LOOP

	DEC 8, XIX
	ADD XIX, 320
	DJNZ WA, DRAW_CHAR_J_LOOP

	POP BC
	POP XHL
	POP XIX
	RET


GET_PAGE_PTR:
	; A: pageId

	CP A, 0FFh
	JP NE, PAGEID_NOT_FF
	LD XWA, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_3)
	RET

PAGEID_NOT_FF:
	CP A, 0FEh
	JP NE, PAGEID_NOT_FE
	LD XWA, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_2)
	RET

PAGEID_NOT_FE:
	CP A, 3
	JP UGT, PAGEID_OTHER_VALUE
	AND WA, 3   ; 10000h bytes per page = enough for 320x200 pixels
	LD QWA, WA
	LD WA, 0
	ADD XWA, PAGE_BITMAP_0
	RET

PAGEID_OTHER_VALUE:
	LD XWA, PAGE_BITMAP_0
	RET


; _read_vm_var: Read vm_variable[A] into DE
; Input: A = variable index (0-255)
; Output: DE = variable value (16-bit signed)
; Clobbers: XIY, XWA
_read_vm_var:
	LD W, 0
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	LD XIY, VM_VARIABLES
	ADD XIY, XWA
	LD DE, (XIY)
	RET

; _write_vm_var: Write DE to vm_variable[A]
; Input: A = variable index (0-255), DE = value
; Clobbers: XIY, XWA
_write_vm_var:
	LD W, 0
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	LD XIY, VM_VARIABLES
	ADD XIY, XWA
	LD (XIY), DE
	RET

CHECK_THREAD_REQUESTS:

	; Check if a part switch has been requested
	LD WA, (REQUESTED_NEXT_PART)
	CP WA, 0
	JP EQ, _no_part_switch
	; Part switch requested - call initForPart
	CALL initForPart
	LDW (REQUESTED_NEXT_PART), 0
_no_part_switch:

	LD A, 0
_check_thread_reqs__loop:

	; thread->state = thread->requested_state;
	PUSH WA
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XWA, VM_IS_CHANNEL_ACTIVE
	LD E, (XWA + REQUESTED_STATE)
	CP E, NO_STATE_REQUEST
	JP EQ, _no_state_request
	LD (XWA + CURRENT_STATE), E
_no_state_request:
	POP WA

	PUSH WA
	SLA 2, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XWA, THREADS_DATA
	LD DE, (XWA + REQUESTED_PC_OFFSET)
	POP WA
	CP DE, NO_REQUEST
	JP EQ, _check_thread_reqs__next_loop

	PUSH WA
	SLA 2, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XWA, THREADS_DATA
	LD BC, (XWA + REQUESTED_PC_OFFSET)
	CP DE, DELETE_THIS_THREAD
	JP NE, _dont_delete_this_thread
	LD BC, INACTIVE_THREAD
_dont_delete_this_thread:
	LDW (XWA + PC_OFFSET), BC
	LDW (XWA + REQUESTED_PC_OFFSET), NO_REQUEST
	POP WA

_check_thread_reqs__next_loop:
	INC A
	CP A, 64
	JP NE, _check_thread_reqs__loop

_end_of__check_thread_reqs:
	RET

.
NEXT_THREAD:
	CALL INPUT_UPDATE_PLAYER

	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (CURRENT_THREAD)

_next_thread__do_loop:
	INC A
	CP A, 64
	JP NE, _not_end_of_frame
	; == END OF FRAME ==
	LDB (CURRENT_THREAD), 0
	CALL CHECK_THREAD_REQUESTS
	LD A, 0FEh
	CALL UPDATE_DISPLAY
	LD A, 0
_not_end_of_frame:

;	while(current->state == FROZEN || current->PC == INACTIVE_THREAD);
	PUSH WA
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XWA, VM_IS_CHANNEL_ACTIVE
	LD E, (XWA + CURRENT_STATE)
	POP WA
	CP E, FROZEN
	JP EQ, _next_thread__do_loop

	PUSH WA
	SLA 2, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XWA, THREADS_DATA
	LD DE, (XWA + PC_OFFSET)
	POP WA
	CP DE, INACTIVE_THREAD
	JP EQ, _next_thread__do_loop

_exit_do_loop:
	LD (CURRENT_THREAD), A
	SLA 2, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XWA, THREADS_DATA
	LD DE, (XWA + PC_OFFSET) 	;	PC = current->PC;
	LD (VM_PC), DE
	RET


EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION:
	PUSH XIX
	PUSH XIY

	LD IX, (VM_PC)
	EXTZ XIX
	ADD XIX, INTRO_BYTECODE			; FIXME

FETCH_OPCODE:
	LD A, (XIX)  ; opcode = fetch_byte();
	INC XIX

	BIT 7, A	; if (opcode & 0x80)
	JP Z, OPCODE_BIT_7_NOT_SET

	; ====  VIDEO instruction (0x80) ====
_OPCODE_0x80:
;		uint16_t offset = ((opcode << 8) | fetch_byte()) * 2;
	LD W, A
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	PUSH WA				; save offset_raw = (opcode << 8) | low_byte

	; Read x from bytecode (XIX still points to bytecode stream)
	LD D, 0
	LD E, (XIX)			; x = fetch_byte()
	INC XIX
	PUSH DE				; save x

	; Read y from bytecode
	LD A, (XIX)			; y = fetch_byte()
	INC XIX
	LD H, 0
	LD L, A				; HL = y

	; Save bytecode position (past all 4 consumed bytes: opcode, offset_lo, x, y)
	PUSH HL				; save y
	LD XDE, XIX
	SUB XDE, INTRO_BYTECODE
	LD (VM_PC), DE
	POP HL				; restore y

	; Restore x
	POP DE				; DE = x

	; Compute offset and set up video data pointer
	POP WA				; WA = offset_raw
	SLA 1, WA			; offset *= 2
	EXTZ XWA
	LD XIX, INTRO_VIDEO_1
	ADD XIX, XWA

;		if (y > 199)
;		{
;			x += (y - 199);
;			y = 199;
;		}
	CP HL, 199
	JP ULE, _0x80_y_ok	; if y <= 199, skip (normal case)
	; y > 199: adjust coordinates
	ADD DE, HL
	SUB DE, 199			; x += (y - 199)
	LD HL, 199			; y = 199
_0x80_y_ok:

	LD BC, 0FF40h
	CALL readAndDrawPolygon

	JP _after_PC_update

OPCODE_BIT_7_NOT_SET:
	BIT 6, A	; if (opcode & 0x40)
	JP Z, OPCODE_BIT_6_NOT_SET

	; ====  VIDEO instruction (0x40) ====
_OPCODE_0x40:
	; A = opcode (bit 6 set), save for bit testing
	LD B, A

	; offset = fetch_word() * 2 (big-endian)
	LD WA, (XIX)
	EX W, A				; byte-swap
	SLA 1, WA			; offset *= 2
	INC 2, XIX
	PUSH WA				; save offset [stack: offset]

	; x = fetch_byte()
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD D, 0
	LD E, A				; DE = x (byte value)

	; X addressing mode based on opcode bits 5,4
	BIT 5, B
	JP NZ, _0x40_x_bit5set

	; bit 5 clear: extended x
	BIT 4, B
	JP NZ, _0x40_x_var
	; x = (x << 8) | fetch_byte() - 16-bit immediate
	LD D, E
	LD E, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	JP _0x40_x_done

_0x40_x_var:
	; x = read_vm_variable(x) - A still has x
	CALL _read_vm_var	; DE = vm_var[x]
	JP _0x40_x_done

_0x40_x_bit5set:
	; bit 5 set
	BIT 4, B
	JP Z, _0x40_x_done
	; x += 0x100
	ADD DE, 100h

_0x40_x_done:
	; DE = x
	PUSH DE				; save x [stack: x, offset]

	; y = fetch_byte()
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD H, 0
	LD L, A				; HL = y (byte value)

	; Y addressing mode based on opcode bits 3,2
	BIT 3, B
	JP NZ, _0x40_y_done

	BIT 2, B
	JP NZ, _0x40_y_var
	; y = (y << 8) | fetch_byte() - 16-bit immediate
	LD H, L
	LD L, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	JP _0x40_y_done

_0x40_y_var:
	; y = read_vm_variable(y) - A still has y
	CALL _read_vm_var	; DE = vm_var[y]
	LD HL, DE			; HL = y

_0x40_y_done:
	; HL = y
	PUSH HL				; save y [stack: y, x, offset]

	; Zoom mode based on opcode bits 1,0
	LD C, 40h			; default zoom
	LD A, B
	AND A, 3

	CP A, 0
	JP EQ, _0x40_zoom_done

	CP A, 1
	JP NE, _0x40_zoom_not_1
	; zoom = read_vm_variable(fetch_byte())
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	CALL _read_vm_var	; DE = vm_var[A]
	LD C, E				; zoom = low byte of variable
	JP _0x40_zoom_done

_0x40_zoom_not_1:
	CP A, 2
	JP NE, _0x40_zoom_case3
	; fetch_byte() and discard
	INC XIX
	JP _0x40_zoom_done

_0x40_zoom_case3:
	; case 3: m_useVideo2 = true, zoom = 0x40
	; TODO: select INTRO_VIDEO_2 when available

_0x40_zoom_done:
	; C = zoom

	; Save bytecode position (all variable-length bytes consumed)
	LD XDE, XIX
	SUB XDE, INTRO_BYTECODE
	LD (VM_PC), DE

	; Restore parameters from stack
	POP HL				; HL = y
	POP DE				; DE = x
	POP WA				; WA = offset

	; Set up polygon data pointer
	EXTZ XWA
	LD XIX, INTRO_VIDEO_1
	ADD XIX, XWA

	; B = color (0xFF = BLACK), C = zoom (already set)
	LD B, 0FFh

	; DE = x, HL = y, BC = color|zoom, XIX = data pointer
	CALL readAndDrawPolygon

	JP _after_PC_update

	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_MOVCONST

	LD A, (XIX)		; uint8_t variableId = fetch_byte();
	INC XIX
	; Calculate destination pointer first
	LD XIY, VM_VARIABLES
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XIY, XWA

	LD WA, (XIX)	; int16_t value = fetch_word();
	EX W, A			; byte-swap: bytecode is big-endian
	INC 2, XIX
	LD (XIY), WA	; write_vm_variable(variableId, value);

	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_MOV

	LD A, (XIX)		; uint8_t dstVariableId = fetch_byte();
	INC XIX
	PUSH WA			; save dstVariableId
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)		; uint8_t srcVariableId = fetch_byte();

	LD XIY, VM_VARIABLES
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XIY, XWA
	LD DE, (XIY)	; value = read_vm_variable(srcVariableId);

	POP WA			; restore dstVariableId
	LD XIY, VM_VARIABLES
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XIY, XWA
	LD (XIY), DE	; write_vm_variable(dstVariableId, value);

	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_ADD

	LD A, (XIX)		; uint8_t dstVariableId = fetch_byte();

	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)		; uint8_t srcVariableId = fetch_byte();

	LD XIY, VM_VARIABLES
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XIY, XWA
	LD DE, (XIY)	; srcValue = read_vm_variable(srcVariableId);

	POP WA			; restore dstVariableId

	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA

	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_ADD_CONST
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)		; uint8_t variableId = fetch_byte();

	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XIY, XWA

	LD WA, (XIX)	; int16_t value = fetch_word();

	LD (VM_STACK_POINTER), XIY
	LD (VM_PC), WA

	CP A, 6
	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_PAUSE_THREAD
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (CURRENT_THREAD)
	SLA 2, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XWA, THREADS_DATA

	LD DE, (XWA + REQUESTED_PC_OFFSET)
	CP DE, NO_REQUEST
	JP NE, _pausethread_after_setting_request

	EX W, A

	LD WA, 0

INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_DJNZ:


	; ====  COND_JUMP instruction  ====
	CP A, 0Ah
	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_COND_JUMP

	INC XIX

	LD A, (XIX)		; uint8_t v = fetch_byte();
	INC XIX
	CALL _read_vm_var
	PUSH DE			; save b = read_vm_variable(v) on stack

	LD A, (XIX)		; uint8_t c = fetch_byte();
	INC XIX

	; Determine operand 'a' based on subopcode bits
	BIT 7, B
	JP Z, _condJmp_not_var
	; bit 7 set: a = read_vm_variable(c)
	CALL _read_vm_var	; A still has c; DE = vm_var[c]
	JP _condJmp_have_a
_condJmp_not_var:
	BIT 6, B
	JP Z, _condJmp_byte_literal
	; bit 6 set: a = (c << 8) | fetch_byte()  (16-bit immediate)
	LD D, A
	LD E, (XIX)		; fetch extra low byte
	INC XIX
	JP _condJmp_have_a
_condJmp_byte_literal:
	; neither bit set: a = c (zero-extended byte, per reference)
	LD E, A
	LD D, 0
_condJmp_have_a:
	; DE = a (RHS), (XSP) = b (LHS), B = subopcode
	POP HL			; HL = b (LHS)

	; Save comparison type (subopcode & 7) before clobbering B
	LD A, B
	AND A, 7
	PUSH WA			; save comparison type on stack

	; Fetch the jump target word (big-endian, always consumed)
	LD WA, (XIX)
	EX W, A			; byte-swap: bytecode is big-endian
	LD BC, WA		; BC = jump offset
	INC 2, XIX

	; Restore comparison type
	POP WA			; A = comparison type

	; Dispatch comparison: b (HL) vs a (DE)
	CP A, 0			; case 0: eq (b == a)
	JP NE, _condJmp_not_eq

	JP EQ, _condJmp_taken

	JP NE, _condJmp_taken
	JP _condJmp_not_taken

	JP NE, _condJmp_not_gt
	CP HL, DE
	JP GT, _condJmp_taken
	JP _condJmp_not_taken
_condJmp_not_gt:
	CP A, 3			; case 3: ge (b >= a)
	JP NE, _condJmp_not_ge
	CP HL, DE
	JP GE, _condJmp_taken
	JP _condJmp_not_taken
_condJmp_not_ge:
	CP A, 4			; case 4: lt (b < a)
	JP NE, _condJmp_not_lt
	CP HL, DE
	JP LT, _condJmp_taken
	JP _condJmp_not_taken
_condJmp_not_lt:
	; case 5: le (b <= a) - default for any remaining
	CP HL, DE
	JP LE, _condJmp_taken

_condJmp_not_taken:
	JP _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION

_condJmp_taken:
	LD (VM_PC), BC
	JP _after_PC_update

	EXTZ XWA

	; ====  SELECT_VIDEO_PAGE instruction  ====

INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_FILL_VIDEO_PAGE:

	CP A, 0Fh
	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_COPY_VIDEO_PAGE

	INC XIX
	LD C, (XIX)		; byte dstPageId
	INC XIX

	LD A, C
	CALL GET_PAGE_PTR
	PUSH XWA		; save dst pointer on stack

	; Check for simple copy: srcPageId >= 0xFE
	CP B, 0FEh
	JP UGE, _copypage_simple

	; Check scroll mode: (srcPageId & 0xBF) has bit 7 set?
	LD A, B
	AND A, 0BFh
	BIT 7, A
	JP Z, _copypage_simple_masked

	; Actual source page = srcPageId & 3
	AND A, 3
	CALL GET_PAGE_PTR
	LD XDE, XWA		; XDE = src page base

	JP LT, _copypage_scroll_skip
	CP HL, 199
	JP GT, _copypage_scroll_skip

	LD BC, 200		; h = screen height
	POP XWA			; XWA = dst base
	PUSH XWA		; re-push for later pop

	CP HL, 0
	JP GE, _copypage_vscroll_positive

	; vscroll < 0: h += vscroll, src_y0 = -vscroll
	ADD BC, HL		; h += vscroll (vscroll is negative)
	LD WA, 0
	SUB WA, HL		; WA = -vscroll = src_y0
	; Advance src pointer by src_y0 * 320
	PUSH BC
	LD BC, 320
	EXTZ XWA
	MUL XWA, BC
	ADD XDE, XWA	; src += src_y0 * 320
	POP BC

_copypage_vscroll_positive:
	; vscroll >= 0: h -= vscroll, dest_y0 = vscroll
	SUB BC, HL		; h -= vscroll
	LD WA, HL		; WA = vscroll = dest_y0
	; Advance dst pointer by dest_y0 * 320
	POP XHL			; XHL = dst base (from stack)
	PUSH BC
	LD BC, 320
	EXTZ XWA
	MUL XWA, BC
	ADD XHL, XWA	; dst += dest_y0 * 320
	POP BC
	PUSH XHL		; re-push adjusted dst

_copypage_do_scroll:
	; Copy h scanlines (BC = h, XDE = src, stack top = dst)
	POP XHL			; XHL = dst pointer
	; Convert h scanlines to dword count: h * 320 / 4 = h * 80
	LD WA, BC		; WA = h
	EXTZ XWA
	LD BC, 80
	MUL XWA, BC		; XWA = h * 80
	LD BC, WA		; BC = dword count
_copypage_scroll_loop:
	LD XWA, (XDE)
	LD (XHL), XWA
	INC 4, XDE
	INC 4, XHL
	DJNZ BC, _copypage_scroll_loop
	JP _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION

_copypage_scroll_skip:
	POP XWA			; clean up stack (dst pointer)
	JP _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION

_copypage_simple_masked:
	; srcPageId after masking still doesn't have bit 7 set - use masked value
	CALL GET_PAGE_PTR
	LD XDE, XWA
	JP _copypage_do_simple

_copypage_simple:
	; Simple copy: get src page from original srcPageId
	LD A, B
	CALL GET_PAGE_PTR

_copypage_do_simple:
	POP XHL			; XHL = dst page pointer (from stack)
	LD BC, 320 * 200 / 4
_copy_videopage_loop:
	LD XWA, (XDE)
	LD (XHL), XWA
	INC 4, XDE
	INC 4, XHL
	DJNZ BC, _copy_videopage_loop

	CALL _read_vm_var	; DE = vm_var[0x67]

	JP NE, _blit_no_hack

	LD DE, 021h

	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_KILL_THREAD

	LD A, (CURRENT_THREAD)

	EXTZ XWA

INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_SUB:


	; ====  AND instruction  ====
	CP A, 14h
	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_AND
	; vm_variable[id] &= value
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)		; uint8_t variableId = fetch_byte();
	INC XIX
	LD XIY, VM_VARIABLES
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XIY, XWA
	LD WA, (XIX)	; int16_t value = fetch_word();

INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_AND:

	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)		; uint8_t variableId = fetch_byte();
	INC XIX

content.text:
Build succeeds. The fix replaces the broken `QWA`-based address computation with explicit compare-and-branch for each page ID (0-3), ensuring the full 32-bit page buffer address is correctly loaded.

**Root cause:** `LD QWA, WA` copies `WA` (the page ID) to the **previous register bank's WA** — it does NOT modify `XWA`'s upper 16 bits. Then `LD WA, 0; ADD XWA, PAGE_BITMAP_0` computes an address using undefined upper bits, so GET_PAGE_PTR returned garbage for all page IDs 0-3. Every fill, select, and blit operation was reading/writing wrong memory.

Try `make test` and see if the intro now renders polygon content instead of a solid color.

- Palette resource is only 2048 bytes
- So it reads past the end of the palette data, into whatever code/data follows INTRO_PALETTES in ROM


- This would load garbage values into the VGA palette, potentially rendering all colors identically if that adjacent memory happens to be uniform. I need to fix this bug.

content.text:
The palette resource is 2048 bytes (64 palettes × 32 bytes). If the code uses the full 16-bit value 0x01FF, the offset would be 0x01FF × 32 = 16,352 — way past the 2048-byte palette data! It reads garbage from adjacent ROM data.

Let me fix SETUP_PALETTE:

; (c) 2024 Felipe Correa da Silva Sanches <juca@members.fsf.org>
; Licensed under GPL version 2 or later.
;
; This is a port of the Another World VM (initially supporting only non-interactive
; playback of the game intro) to run from an extension board on a
; Technics SX-KN5000 musical keyboard.
;
; This program must replace the hd-ae5000_v2_01i.ic4 ROM of the extension board.
;
; This implementation is derived from my port of the Another World VM
; as a high-level emulation on MAME
;
; And that port was derived from Fabien Sanglard's AW-VM available at:
; https://github.com/fabiensanglard/Another-World-Bytecode-Interpreter
;
; The assembler I am using is compiled from source-code downloaded from
; http://john.ccac.rwth-aachen.de:8000/as/index.html
;
; Game assets must be extracted from an original copy of the game
; using the scripts provided at:
; https://github.com/felipesanches/AnotherWorld_VMTools
;
; === EQU Constants (shared) ===
PC_OFFSET			EQU 0  ; 16 bits
REQUESTED_PC_OFFSET	EQU 2  ; 16 bits
INACTIVE_THREAD		EQU 0FFFFh
DELETE_THIS_THREAD	EQU 0FFFEh
NO_REQUEST 			EQU 0FFFFh

CURRENT_STATE	EQU 0  ; boolean stored as a byte
REQUESTED_STATE	EQU 1  ; boolean stored as a byte

FROZEN	EQU 0
NOT_FROZEN EQU 1
NO_STATE_REQUEST EQU 0FFh

; These off-screen video pages are stored in external RAM:
; MAINCPU: in DRAM at 0x020000-0x05FFFF
; EXTENSION: in extension board SRAM at 0x240000-0x27FFFF
	ifdef TARGET_MAINCPU
PAGE_BITMAP_0 EQU 020000h
PAGE_BITMAP_1 EQU 030000h
PAGE_BITMAP_2 EQU 040000h
PAGE_BITMAP_3 EQU 050000h
	endif
	ifdef TARGET_EXTENSION
PAGE_BITMAP_0 EQU 240000h
PAGE_BITMAP_1 EQU 250000h
PAGE_BITMAP_2 EQU 260000h
PAGE_BITMAP_3 EQU 270000h
	endif

; VM variable indices (used by the game engine)
VM_VARIABLE_RANDOM_SEED		EQU 03Ch
VM_VARIABLE_LAST_KEYCHAR	EQU 0C5h
VM_VARIABLE_HERO_POS_UP_DOWN	EQU 0E5h
VM_VARIABLE_HERO_POS_JUMP_DOWN	EQU 0DCh
VM_VARIABLE_HERO_POS_LEFT_RIGHT	EQU 0E9h
VM_VARIABLE_HERO_POS_MASK	EQU 0FAh
VM_VARIABLE_HERO_ACTION		EQU 0FBh
VM_VARIABLE_HERO_ACTION_POS_MASK EQU 0FBh
VM_VARIABLE_SCROLL_Y		EQU 0F9h

; Game part IDs
GAME_PART_INTRO			EQU 03E80h
NUM_MEM_LIST			EQU 091h

CALC_LINE_XMAX_AND_XMIN:
	; int16_t xmax = MAX(x1, x2);
	LD WA, (X1)
	CP WA, (X2)
	JP GT, XMAX_OK
	LD WA, (X2)
XMAX_OK:
	LD (LINE_XMAX), WA
	
	; int16_t xmin = MIN(x1, x2);
	LD WA, (X1)
	CP WA, (X2)
	JP LT, XMIN_OK
	LD WA, (X2)
XMIN_OK:
	LD (LINE_XMIN), WA
	RET

drawLineN:
	; Inputs:
	; C = color
	PUSH XIX
	PUSH XHL
	
	CALL CALC_LINE_XMAX_AND_XMIN

	; for (int16_t x=xmin; x<=xmax; x++)
	; 	m_curPagePtr1->pix(m_hliney, x) = color;
	LD XIX, (CUR_LINE)
	LD HL, (LINE_XMIN)
	EXTS XHL
	ADD XIX, XHL
	LD HL, (LINE_XMAX)
	SUB HL, (LINE_XMIN)

drawLineN_loop:
	LDB (XIX), C
	INC XIX
	DJNZ HL, drawLineN_loop
	
	POP XHL
	POP XIX
	RET

drawLineP:
	; Copy pixels from PAGE_BITMAP_0 to curPagePtr1
	PUSH XIX
	PUSH XIY
	PUSH XHL

	CALL CALC_LINE_XMAX_AND_XMIN

	; Destination: CUR_LINE + LINE_XMIN (in curPagePtr1)
	LD XIX, (CUR_LINE)
	LD HL, (LINE_XMIN)
	EXTS XHL
	ADD XIX, XHL

	; Source: PAGE_BITMAP_0 + HLINEY*320 + LINE_XMIN
	LD XIY, PAGE_BITMAP_0
	LD XWA, 0
	LD WA, (HLINEY)
	LD DE, 320
	MUL XWA, DE
	ADD XIY, XWA
	LD XHL, 0
	LD HL, (LINE_XMIN)
	EXTS XHL
	ADD XIY, XHL

	; Loop: copy xmax-xmin+1 pixels
	LD HL, (LINE_XMAX)
	SUB HL, (LINE_XMIN)

drawLineP_loop:
	LD C, (XIY)			; color = page_bitmap_0[y][x]
	LDB (XIX), C			; curPagePtr1[y][x] = color
	INC XIX
	INC XIY
	DJNZ HL, drawLineP_loop

	POP XHL
	POP XIY
	POP XIX
	RET

drawLineBlend:
	; Blend: read existing pixel, apply (color & 7) | 8
	PUSH XIX
	PUSH XHL

	CALL CALC_LINE_XMAX_AND_XMIN

	; curPagePtr1 scanline pointer
	LD XIX, (CUR_LINE)
	LD HL, (LINE_XMIN)
	EXTS XHL
	ADD XIX, XHL
	LD HL, (LINE_XMAX)
	SUB HL, (LINE_XMIN)

drawLineBlend_loop:
	LD C, (XIX)			; color = curPagePtr1[y][x]
	ANDB C, 07h			; color &= 0x07
	ORB C, 08h			; color |= 0x08
	LDB (XIX), C			; curPagePtr1[y][x] = blended color
	INC XIX
	DJNZ HL, drawLineBlend_loop

	POP XHL
	POP XIX
	RET

drawPoint:
	PUSH XIX
	LD WA, 0
	LD WA, HL
	MUL XWA, 320
	; FIXME: do we need to zero the upper 16 bits of XDE here?
	ADD XWA, XDE
	LD XIX, 01a0000h
	ADD XIX, XWA
	LD (XIX), BC
	POP XIX
	RET

video MACRO type,data,x,y
	LD XIX, INTRO_VIDEO_type
	ADD XIX, data
	LD DE, x
	LD HL, y
	LD BC, 0FF40h
	CALL readAndDrawPolygon
	ENDM


text MACRO stringid, x, y, color
	LD WA, stringid
	LD DE, x
	LD HL, y
	LD B, color
	CALL DRAW_STRING
	ENDM


BREAK:
	; This is a temporary placeholder
	; while we still do not emulate
	; the VM thread execution

	LD A, 0FEh		; end-of-frame
	CALL UPDATE_DISPLAY
	CALL PAUSE
	RET


UPDATE_DISPLAY:
	; A: PageID
	CP A, 0FEh
	JP EQ, _UPDATE_DISPLAY

	CP A, 0FFh
	JP EQ, _UPDATE_DISPLAY_PAGEID_FF

_UPDATE_DISPLAY_PAGEID_NOT_FE_OR_FF:
	CALL GET_PAGE_PTR
	LD (CUR_PAGE_PTR_2), XWA
	JP _UPDATE_DISPLAY
	
_UPDATE_DISPLAY_PAGEID_FF:
	LD XIY, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_2)
	LD XWA, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_3)
	LD (CUR_PAGE_PTR_2), XWA
	LD (CUR_PAGE_PTR_3), XIY

_UPDATE_DISPLAY:
	LD XHL, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_2)
	LD XDE, 001a0000h + 20*320	; vga memory, skipping the first 20 lines because the image has 320x200 resolution and the screen has 320x240
	LD XBC, 320 * 200 / 2		; bitmap data length in 16-bit words (320x200 pixels)
	LDIRW
	RET


VIDEO_START:
	LD XIX, PAGE_BITMAP_2
	LD (CUR_PAGE_PTR_1), XIX
	LD (CUR_PAGE_PTR_2), XIX
	LD XIX, PAGE_BITMAP_1
	LD (CUR_PAGE_PTR_3), XIX
	RET

; initForPart: Reset all threads and prepare for a new game part
; Input: WA = partId
initForPart:
	LD (CURRENT_PART_ID), WA

	; Reset VM state
	LD XIX, VM_STACK
	LD (VM_STACK_POINTER), XIX

	; Reset all threads: inactive and unfrozen
	LD IX, 0
_initForPart_loop:
	PUSH IX
	SLA 2, IX
	EXTZ XIX
	ADD XIX, THREADS_DATA
	LDW (XIX + PC_OFFSET), INACTIVE_THREAD
	LDW (XIX + REQUESTED_PC_OFFSET), NO_REQUEST
	POP IX

	PUSH IX
	SLA 1, IX
	EXTZ XIX
	ADD XIX, VM_IS_CHANNEL_ACTIVE
	LD (XIX + CURRENT_STATE), NOT_FROZEN
	LD (XIX + REQUESTED_STATE), NO_STATE_REQUEST
	POP IX

	INC IX
	CP IX, 64
	JP NE, _initForPart_loop

	; Start thread 0 at PC=0
	LDW (THREADS_DATA + PC_OFFSET), 0

	; Set variable 0xE4 = 0x14 (as per reference)
	LD A, 0E4h
	LD DE, 014h
	CALL _write_vm_var

	; Note: Full part switching would require bank-switching bytecode,
	; palettes, and video data. Only intro resources are available.
	RET


GAME_RESET:
	CALL VIDEO_START

	; Zero all VM variables (256 x 16-bit = 512 bytes)
	LD XDE, VM_VARIABLES
	LD WA, 0
	LD BC, 256
_zero_vars_loop:
	LD (XDE), WA
	INC 2, XDE
	DJNZ BC, _zero_vars_loop

	LDB (CURRENT_THREAD), 0
	LDW (VM_PC), 0
	LD XIX, VM_STACK
	LD (VM_STACK_POINTER), XIX

	; All threads are initially disabled and unfrozen
	LD IX, 0
_setup_threads__loop:

	PUSH IX
	SLA 2, IX
	EXTZ XIX
	ADD XIX, THREADS_DATA
	LDW (XIX + PC_OFFSET), INACTIVE_THREAD
	LDW (XIX + REQUESTED_PC_OFFSET), NO_REQUEST
	POP IX

	PUSH IX
	SLA 1, IX
	EXTZ XIX
	ADD XIX, VM_IS_CHANNEL_ACTIVE
	LD (XIX + CURRENT_STATE), NOT_FROZEN
	LD (XIX + REQUESTED_STATE), NO_STATE_REQUEST
	POP IX

	INC IX
	CP IX, 64
	JP NE, _setup_threads__loop

	; Start thread 0 at PC=0 (matching initForPart behavior)
	LDW (THREADS_DATA + PC_OFFSET), 0

	; Initialize VM_VARIABLE_RANDOM_SEED with a fixed seed (no RTC available)
	LD A, VM_VARIABLE_RANDOM_SEED
	LD DE, 1234h			; Fixed seed value
	CALL _write_vm_var

	; VM_HACK_INIT_VAR_54_WITH_81: Required for Interplay logo display
	LD A, 054h
	LD DE, 0081h
	CALL _write_vm_var

	; Initialize part tracking
	LDW (REQUESTED_NEXT_PART), 0
	LDW (CURRENT_PART_ID), GAME_PART_INTRO

	RET

ENTRY:
	EI 06 ; DISABLE INTERRUPTS

	CALL GAME_RESET

MAIN_LOOP:
	CALL EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION
	JP MAIN_LOOP

LONG_PAUSE:
	LD BC, 0
LONG_PAUSE_LOOP1:
	LD DE, 080h
LONG_PAUSE_LOOP2:
	DJNZ DE, LONG_PAUSE_LOOP2
	DJNZ BC, LONG_PAUSE_LOOP1
	RET

PAUSE:
	LD BC, 0
PAUSE_LOOP1:
	LD DE, 01h
PAUSE_LOOP2:
	DJNZ DE, PAUSE_LOOP2
	DJNZ BC, PAUSE_LOOP1
	RET

readAndDrawPolygon:
	; Inputs:
	; XIX: polygon data pointer
	; DE: x
	; HL: y
	; B: color (Black = FFh)
	; C: zoom (default = 40h)
	PUSH DE
	PUSH HL
	PUSH BC
	
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	CP A, 0C0H
	JP ULT, VALUE_IS_LT_C0

VALUE_IS_GTE_C0:

	CP B, 128
	JP ULT, COLOR_BIT_7_IS_OFF
	LD B, A
	ANDB B, 03Fh				;	if (color & 0x80) color = i & 0x3F;
COLOR_BIT_7_IS_OFF:
	
	;(&m_polygonData[m_data_offset], zoom);
	call readVertices

	; (color, pt)
	CALL fillPolygon

	JP end_of_readAndDrawPolygon

VALUE_IS_LT_C0: ; for now, here we simply assume value is == 2 without checking.
	;(zoom, pt)

	PUSH XIX
	PUSH BC ; C=zoom
	PUSH DE ; x
	PUSH HL ; y
	CALL readAndDrawPolygonHierarchy
	POP HL
	POP DE
	POP BC
	POP XIX

end_of_readAndDrawPolygon:
	POP BC
	POP HL
	POP DE
	RET

readVertices:
	PUSH XIX
	PUSH DE
	PUSH HL
	PUSH BC

	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD DE, 0
	LD E, C
	MUL XWA, DE			; *= ZOOM
	SRAW 6, WA			; /= default_zoom (40h)
	LD (POLYGON_BBOX_W), WA

	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD DE, 0
	LD E, C
	MUL XWA, DE			; *= ZOOM
	SRAW 6, WA			; /= default_zoom (40h)
	LD (POLYGON_BBOX_H), WA

	LD B, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD (POLYGON_NUM_POINTS), B

	LD XIY, POLYGON_POINTS
	LD DE, 0
	LD E, C

READ_THE_COORDINATES:

	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	MUL XWA, DE			; *= ZOOM
	SRAW 6, WA			; /= default_zoom (40h)
	LD (XIY), WA
	INC 2, XIY

	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	MUL XWA, DE			; *= ZOOM
	SRAW 6, WA			; /= default_zoom (40h)
	LD (XIY), WA
	INC 2, XIY

	DJNZ B, READ_THE_COORDINATES	

	POP BC
	POP HL
	POP DE
	POP XIX	
	RET

fillPolygon:
	; DE: x
	; HL: y
	; B: color (Black = FFh)

	PUSH BC
	LD C, B
	LD B, 0

	;if (m_polygon.bbox_w == 0 && m_polygon.bbox_h == 1 && m_polygon.numPoints == 4)
	CPW (POLYGON_BBOX_W), 0
	JP NZ, NOT_A_POINT
	CPW (POLYGON_BBOX_H), 1
	JP NZ, NOT_A_POINT
	CP (POLYGON_NUM_POINTS), 4
	JP NZ, NOT_A_POINT
	
	;(color, pt.x, pt.y);
	CALL drawPoint
	JP end_of_fillPolygon
	
	NOT_A_POINT:

	PUSH IX
	; int16_t xmin = pt.x - m_polygon.bbox_w / 2;
	LD IX, (POLYGON_BBOX_W)
	SRA 1, IX
	LD (POLYGON_XMIN), DE
	SUB (POLYGON_XMIN), IX

	; int16_t xmax = pt.x + m_polygon.bbox_w / 2;
	LD (POLYGON_XMAX), DE
	ADD (POLYGON_XMAX), IX

	; int16_t ymin = pt.y - m_polygon.bbox_h / 2;
	LD IX, (POLYGON_BBOX_H)
	SRA 1, IX
	LD (POLYGON_YMIN), HL
	SUB (POLYGON_YMIN), IX

	; int16_t ymax = pt.y + m_polygon.bbox_h / 2;	
	LD (POLYGON_YMAX), HL
	ADD (POLYGON_YMAX), IX
	POP IX


	;if (xmin >= 320 || xmax < 0 || ymin >= 200 || ymax < 0)
	;	return;
	CPW (POLYGON_XMIN), 320
	JP GE, end_of_fillPolygon
	CPW (POLYGON_XMAX), 0
	JP LT, end_of_fillPolygon
	CPW (POLYGON_YMIN), 200
	JP GE, end_of_fillPolygon
	CPW (POLYGON_YMAX), 0
	JP LT, end_of_fillPolygon


	LD WA, (POLYGON_YMIN)
	LD (HLINEY), WA

	LD XIX, POLYGON_POINTS				; i = 0;
	LD XIY, POLYGON_POINTS
	LD XWA, 0
	LD A, (POLYGON_NUM_POINTS)
	DEC A
	SLA 2, XWA
	ADD XIY, XWA						; j = m_polygon.numPoints - 1;

	; x2 = m_polygon.points[i].x + xmin;
	LD WA, (XIX)
	ADD WA, (POLYGON_XMIN)
	LD (X2), WA

	; x1 = m_polygon.points[j].x + xmin;
	LD WA, (XIY)
	ADD WA, (POLYGON_XMIN)
	LD (X1), WA

	INC 4, XIX		; 	i++;
	DEC 4, XIY		; 	j--;


	CP C, 10h
	JP Z, BLEND
	JP UGT, LINE_P

	LD XHL, drawLineN	; 	drawFct = &another_world_vm_state::drawLineN;
	JP AFTER_SETTING_DRAW_CALLBACK

	LINE_P:
	LD XHL, drawLineP	; 	drawFct = &another_world_vm_state::drawLineP;
	JP AFTER_SETTING_DRAW_CALLBACK

	BLEND:
	LD XHL, drawLineBlend

AFTER_SETTING_DRAW_CALLBACK:

	; uint32_t cpt1 = ((uint32_t) x1) << 16;
	LD WA, (X1)
	EXTS XWA
	SLA 16, XWA
	LD (CPT1), XWA

	; uint32_t cpt2 = ((uint32_t) x2) << 16;
	LD WA, (X2)
	EXTS XWA
	SLA 16, XWA
	LD (CPT2), XWA

POLYGON_RASTER_LOOP:
	DEC 2, (POLYGON_NUM_POINTS)

	CP (POLYGON_NUM_POINTS), 0
	JP Z, end_of_fillPolygon		; 	if (m_polygon.numPoints == 0) break;


	; 	int32_t step1 = calcStep(m_polygon.points[j + 1], m_polygon.points[j], h);
	PUSH XHL ; SAVE DRAW_FUNC_PTR
	PUSH XIX
	PUSH XIY
	
	; pt1 = j+1 / pt2 = j
	LD XIX, XIY
	INC 4, XIX
	LD XHL, STEP1
	CALL calcStep

	POP XIY
	POP XIX

	; 	int32_t step2 = calcStep(m_polygon.points[i - 1], m_polygon.points[i], h);
	PUSH XIX
	PUSH XIY

	; pt1 = i-1 / pt2 = i
	LD XIY, XIX
	DEC 4, XIX
	LD XHL, STEP2
	CALL calcStep

	; CUR_LINE = CUR_PAGE_PTR_1 + HLINEY * 320 (signed multiply for negative HLINEY)
	LD WA, (HLINEY)
	EXTS XWA			; sign-extend HLINEY to 32 bits
	LD DE, 320
	MULS XWA, DE		; XWA = HLINEY * 320 (signed)
	LD XIX, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_1)
	ADD XIX, XWA
	LD (CUR_LINE), XIX

	POP XIY
	POP XIX
	POP XHL ; RESTORE DRAW_FUNC_PTR

	INC 4, XIX		; 	i++;
	DEC 4, XIY		; 	j--;

	LDW (CPT1_LOW), 07FFFh		; 	cpt1 = (cpt1 & 0xFFFF0000) | 0x7FFF;
	LDW (CPT2_LOW), 08000h		; 	cpt2 = (cpt2 & 0xFFFF0000) | 0x8000;

	CPW (POLYGON_H), 0
	JP Z, POLYGON_H_IS_ZERO
	
FOR_H_LOOP:			; for (; h != 0; --h)
	CPW (HLINEY), 0
	JP LT, AFTER_DRAWFUNC_CALL

	LD WA, (CPT1_HIGH)		; x1 = cpt1 >> 16;
	LD (X1), WA

	LD WA, (CPT2_HIGH)		; x2 = cpt2 >> 16;
	LD (X2), WA


	; if (x1 < 320 && x2 >= 0)
	CPW (X1), 320
	JP GE, AFTER_DRAWFUNC_CALL
	CPW (X2), 0
	JP LT, AFTER_DRAWFUNC_CALL

	;	if (x1 < 0) x1 = 0;
	CPW (X1), 0
	JP GE, X1_NOT_NEGATIVE	
	LDW (X1), 0
X1_NOT_NEGATIVE:

	;   if (x2 > 319) x2 = 319;
	CPW (X2), 319
	JP LE, X2_LESS_THAN_SCREEN_W
	LDW (X2), 319
X2_LESS_THAN_SCREEN_W:
	
	;(x1, x2, color);
	CALL (XHL) ; drawfunc

AFTER_DRAWFUNC_CALL:

	LD WA, (STEP1_LOW)
	ADD (CPT1_LOW), WA
	LD WA, (STEP1_HIGH)
	ADC (CPT1_HIGH), WA	; 	cpt1 += step1;

	LD WA, (STEP2_LOW)
	ADD (CPT2_LOW), WA
	LD WA, (STEP2_HIGH)
	ADC (CPT2_HIGH), WA	; 	cpt2 += step2;

	INCW (HLINEY)

	; Advance CUR_LINE by 320 unconditionally (even for skipped scanlines)
	ADDW (CUR_LINE_LOW), 320
	ADCW (CUR_LINE_HIGH), 0

	CPW (HLINEY), 199
	JP GT, POLYGON_RASTER_LOOP	; if (m_hliney > 199) return; (signed comparison)

	DECW (POLYGON_H)
	JP NZ, FOR_H_LOOP

	JP POLYGON_RASTER_LOOP

POLYGON_H_IS_ZERO:
	LD WA, (STEP1_LOW)
	ADD (CPT1_LOW), WA
	LD WA, (STEP1_HIGH)
	ADC (CPT1_HIGH), WA	; 	cpt1 += step1;
	
	LD WA, (STEP2_LOW)
	ADD (CPT2_LOW), WA
	LD WA, (STEP2_HIGH)
	ADC (CPT2_HIGH), WA	; 	cpt2 += step2;

	JP POLYGON_RASTER_LOOP

end_of_fillPolygon:
	POP BC
	RET


calcStep:
	; Inputs:
	; XHL = ptr to STEP_1 or STEP_2
	; XIX = p1
	; XIY = p2

	PUSHW 4000h		; uint16_t v = 0x4000;

	LD WA, (XIY)
	LD (DX), WA		; dx = p2.x

	LD WA, (XIX)
	SUB (DX), WA		; dx -= p1.x;

	INC 2, XIX
	INC 2, XIY
	
	LD WA, (XIY)
	LD (POLYGON_H), WA		; dy = p2.y

	LD WA, (XIX)
	SUB (POLYGON_H), WA		; dy -= p1.y

	CPW (POLYGON_H), 0
	JP LE, POLYGON_H_IS_LE_ZERO  ; if (dy>0)
	
	LD WA, (XSP)
	EXTS XWA
	LD DE, (POLYGON_H)
	DIV XWA, DE
	LD (XSP), WA			; v = 0x4000/(POLYGON_H)

POLYGON_H_IS_LE_ZERO:
	
	LD WA, (DX)
	EXTS XWA

	LD DE, (XSP)		; v
	MULS XWA, DE
	SLA 2, XWA
	LD (XHL), XWA		; return dx * v * 4

	INC 2, XSP
	RET


readAndDrawPolygonHierarchy:
	LD D, 0
	LD E, C ; zoom
	;	pt.x -= m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] * zoom / DEFAULT_ZOOM;
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD HL, (XSP + 6)
	MUL XWA, DE			; PT.X *= ZOOM
	SRA 6, WA			; PT.X /= default_zoom (40h)
	SUB HL, WA
	LD (XSP + 6), HL

	;	pt.y -= m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] * zoom / DEFAULT_ZOOM;
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD HL, (XSP + 4)
	MUL XWA, DE			; PT.Y *= ZOOM
	SRA 6, WA			; PT.Y /= default_zoom (40h)
	SUB HL, WA
	LD (XSP + 4), HL

	ld B, 0
	LD C, (XIX)		; num_children - 1
	INC XIX
	INC BC			; BC = num_children

children_loop:
	LD WA, (XIX); offset 
	INC 2, XIX
	EX W, A
	PUSH WA
	PUSHW (XSP + 8); po.x = pt.x
	PUSHW (XSP + 8); po.y = pt.y

	; po.x += m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] * zoom / DEFAULT_ZOOM;
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD HL, (XSP + 2)
	MUL XWA, DE			; PO.X *= ZOOM
	SRA 6, WA			; PO.X /= default_zoom (40h)
	ADD HL, WA
	LD (XSP + 2), HL
	
	; po.y += m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] * zoom / DEFAULT_ZOOM;
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD HL, (XSP)
	MUL XWA, DE			; PO.Y *= ZOOM
	SRA 6, WA			; PO.Y /= default_zoom (40h)
	ADD HL, WA
	LD (XSP), HL

	PUSH DE			; save zoom
	LD DE, 0FFh				; uint16_t color = 0xFF;
	LD HL, (XSP + 6) ;offset
	AND HL, 8000h
	JP Z, OFFSET_BIT15_NOT_SET
	LD DE, 0
	LD E,(XIX)				; 	color = m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] & 0x7F;
	AND E, 7Fh
	INC 2, XIX				; 	m_data_offset++; //and waste a byte...
OFFSET_BIT15_NOT_SET:

	PUSH XIX			;	 uint16_t backup = m_data_offset;
	LD XIX, 0
	LD IX, (XSP + 0Ah) ;offset
	SLA 1, IX		 ; m_data_offset = (offset & 0x7FFF) * 2;
	ADD XIX, INTRO_VIDEO_1
	
	LD HL, DE
	; here L is the computer new color
	; and BC is the children loop counter

	; BC needs to become color | zoom params and
	; DE needs to become x param
	; to the readAndDrawPolygon routine
	
	LD DE, (XSP + 4)	; restore zoom

	PUSH BC
	LD B, L		; color
	LD C, E		; zoom
	LD DE, (XSP + 0ah)		; PO.x
	LD HL, (XSP + 08h)		; PO.y
	; (color, zoom, po)
	CALL readAndDrawPolygon
	POP BC
	POP XIX				; m_data_offset = backup;
	POP DE		; restore zoom

	ADD XSP, 6 ; local vars offset, po.x, po.y (INC only supports 1,2,4,8)
	DJNZ BC, children_loop
	RET


LOAD_SCREEN:
; Input: XHL = pointer to screen bitmap data (320x200 pixels)
; Copies bitmap data to PAGE_BITMAP_0
	LD XDE, PAGE_BITMAP_0
	LD XBC, 320 * 200 / 2		; bitmap data length in 16-bit words (320x200 pixels)
	LDIRW
	RET

SETUP_PALETTE:
	; XWA: paletteID
	; Palette format: 2 bytes per color, 0x0RGB (4 bits per channel)
	; Byte 0: 0000_RRRR (low nibble = red)
	; Byte 1: GGGG_BBBB (high nibble = green, low nibble = blue)
	LD BC,0
	LD XDE, 01703c8h		; VGA 3c8 port (select color palette index)
	LD (XDE), C

	LD BC, 16							; 16 colors per palette
	LD XDE, 01703c9h					; VGA 3c9 port (R, G, B data)
	LD XHL, INTRO_PALETTES
	SLA 5, XWA
	ADD XHL, XWA

PALETTE_LOOP:
	; red: low nibble of byte 0
	LD A, (XHL)
	AND A, 0Fh
	SLA 2, A			; scale 4-bit (0-15) to 6-bit (0-60) for VGA DAC
	LD (XDE), A
	INC XHL

	; green: high nibble of byte 1
	LD A, (XHL)
	SRL 4, A			; logical shift right to extract high nibble
	SLA 2, A			; scale 4-bit to 6-bit for VGA DAC
	LD (XDE), A

	; blue: low nibble of byte 1
	LD A, (XHL)
	AND A, 0Fh
	SLA 2, A			; scale 4-bit to 6-bit for VGA DAC
	LD (XDE), A
	INC XHL

	DJNZ BC, PALETTE_LOOP
	RET


DRAW_STRING:
; WA: stringId
; DE: x
; HL: y
; B: color

	DEC DE
	SLA 3, DE 	;	x = 8 * (x-1);
	LDW (STRING_X0), DE	;	uint16_t x0 = x;
	LD XIX, STRING_INDEX
	EXTS XWA
	ADD XIX, XWA
	ADD XIX, XWA
	LD IX, (XIX)
	EXTS XIX
	ADD XIX, STRING_DATA
	LD C, (XIX)
	INC XIX

DRAW_STRING_LOOP:
	CP C, 0
	RET Z		;	for (; *c != '\0'; c++)

	CP C, 10	;		if (*c == '\n')
	JP NE, NOT_A_LINE_BREAK

LINE_BREAK:
	INC 8, HL			; y+=8;
	LD DE, (STRING_X0)	; x=x0;
	LD C, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	JP DRAW_STRING_LOOP

NOT_A_LINE_BREAK:
	CALL DRAW_CHAR
	INC 8, DE		; x+=8
	LD C, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	JP DRAW_STRING_LOOP


DRAW_CHAR:
	; DE: x
	; HL: y
	; B: color
	; C: character

	LD WA, 0
	LD A, C
	SUB A, 020h
	EXTS XWA
	SLA 3, XWA
	LD XIY, BITMAP_FONT
	ADD XIY, XWA

	PUSH XIX
	PUSH XHL
	PUSH BC

	EXTS XDE
	EXTS XHL

	LD XIX, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_1)
	MUL XHL, 320
	ADD XIX, XHL
	ADD XIX, XDE

	LD WA, 8
DRAW_CHAR_J_LOOP:
	LD C, (XIY)
	INC XIY			; uint8_t row = font[(character - ' ') * 8 + j];

	LD QWA, 8
DRAW_CHAR_I_LOOP:
	SLA 1, C
	JP NC, DONT_PLOT_THIS_PIXEL
	LD (XIX), B
DONT_PLOT_THIS_PIXEL:
	INC XIX
	DJNZ QWA, DRAW_CHAR_I_LOOP

	DEC 8, XIX
	ADD XIX, 320
	DJNZ WA, DRAW_CHAR_J_LOOP

	POP BC
	POP XHL
	POP XIX
	RET


GET_PAGE_PTR:
	; A: pageId

	CP A, 0FFh
	JP NE, PAGEID_NOT_FF
	LD XWA, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_3)
	RET

PAGEID_NOT_FF:
	CP A, 0FEh
	JP NE, PAGEID_NOT_FE
	LD XWA, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_2)
	RET

PAGEID_NOT_FE:
	CP A, 0
	JP NE, _not_page0
	LD XWA, PAGE_BITMAP_0
	RET
_not_page0:
	CP A, 1
	JP NE, _not_page1
	LD XWA, PAGE_BITMAP_1
	RET
_not_page1:
	CP A, 2
	JP NE, _not_page2
	LD XWA, PAGE_BITMAP_2
	RET
_not_page2:
	CP A, 3
	JP NE, _not_page3
	LD XWA, PAGE_BITMAP_3
	RET
_not_page3:
	; Any other page ID defaults to page 0
	LD XWA, PAGE_BITMAP_0
	RET


; _read_vm_var: Read vm_variable[A] into DE
; Input: A = variable index (0-255)
; Output: DE = variable value (16-bit signed)
; Clobbers: XIY, XWA
_read_vm_var:
	LD W, 0
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	LD XIY, VM_VARIABLES
	ADD XIY, XWA
	LD DE, (XIY)
	RET

; _write_vm_var: Write DE to vm_variable[A]
; Input: A = variable index (0-255), DE = value
; Clobbers: XIY, XWA
_write_vm_var:
	LD W, 0
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	LD XIY, VM_VARIABLES
	ADD XIY, XWA
	LD (XIY), DE
	RET
